description: Naval (Modern Wisdom) original sentences for the Sentence Puzzle app, T01–T18 and T21–T30. Built from plaintext /workspace/nova/app/content; not decrypted from .enc files.

sentences.english: Happiness is being satisfied with what you have. Success comes from dissatisfaction. Is success worth it then?
sentences.chinese: 幸福是对自己已经拥有的东西感到满足，而成功往往来自不满足。那么，成功值得付出这样的代价吗？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: Oof. I’m not sure that statement is true anymore.
sentences.chinese: 哎，这话放到现在，我还真不确定它是不是对的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: I made that statement a long time ago, and a lot of these things are just notes to myself and they’re highly contextual.
sentences.chinese: 那是我很久以前说的话了。很多这样的想法其实只是我写给自己的随手笔记，得放回当时的情境里看。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: They come in the moment, they leave in the moment.
sentences.chinese: 它们在那一刻冒出来，也在那一刻离开。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: Happiness is a very complicated topic, but I always like the Socrates story
sentences.chinese: 幸福是个非常复杂的话题，不过我一直很喜欢苏格拉底的那个故事：
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: where he goes into the marketplace and they show him all these luxuries and fineries and he says, “How many things there are in this world that I do not want,”
sentences.chinese: 他走进集市，人们给他看各种奢侈品和华服美饰，他说：“这世上竟有这么多我不想要的东西啊。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: and that’s a form of freedom, so not wanting something is as good as having it.
sentences.chinese: 而这就是一种自由：不想要一样东西，就跟拥有它一样好。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: In the old story with Alexander and Diogenes, Alexander goes out and conquers the world and he meets Diogenes who’s living in a barrel.
sentences.chinese: 在亚历山大和第欧根尼的老故事里，亚历山大出去征服了世界，然后遇到了住在一个木桶里的第欧根尼。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: Diogenes says “Get out of the way, you’re blocking my sun,”
sentences.chinese: 第欧根尼说：“让开，你挡住我的阳光了。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: and Alexander says “Oh how I wish I could be like Diogenes in the next life,” and Diogenes says, “I don’t wish to be Alexander.”
sentences.chinese: 亚历山大说：“唉，我多希望下辈子能像第欧根尼一样。”第欧根尼却说：“我可不想当亚历山大。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: So two paths to happiness: one path is success, you get what you want, you satisfy your material needs,
sentences.chinese: 所以通往幸福有两条路：一条是成功，你得到想要的东西，满足你的物质需求，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: or like Diogenes, where you just don’t want it in the first place.
sentences.chinese: 另一条就像第欧根尼那样，你从一开始就不想要它。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: I’m not sure which one is more valid, and it also depends what you define as success.
sentences.chinese: 我也说不准哪条路更合理，而且还得看你把“成功”定义成什么。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: If the end goal is happiness, then why not cut to the chase and just go straight for it?
sentences.chinese: 如果最终追求的是幸福，那为什么不省去中间那些弯路，直接去追求幸福呢？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 1 · Happiness vs. Success

sentences.english: Does being happy make you less successful?
sentences.chinese: 开心会让人没那么成功吗？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: That is conventional wisdom, that may even be the practical earned experience of your reality.
sentences.chinese: 这是大家普遍相信的看法，甚至可能也是你在现实生活中亲身经历后得出的结论。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: You find that when you’re happy you don’t want anything so you don’t get up and do anything.
sentences.chinese: 你可能会发现，自己一旦很快乐，就没什么特别想得到的东西，也就懒得起身去做事了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: On the other hand, you still gotta do something.
sentences.chinese: 可另一方面，你总还是得做点什么。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: You’re an animal, you’re here to survive, you’re here to replicate, you’re driven, you’re motivated, you’re gonna do something.
sentences.chinese: 你是动物，你来这世上是为了生存、为了繁衍，你有驱动力，你有动力，你总会去做点什么的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: You’re not just gonna sit there all day.
sentences.chinese: 你不会就那么整天坐着不动。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: Some people do, maybe it’s in their nature, but I think most people still want to act, they want to live in the arena.
sentences.chinese: 有些人确实会整天坐着不动，也许那就是他们的天性。但我觉得大多数人还是想行动，想亲自参与人生。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: I found for myself as I’ve become happier—is a big word, but you know, more peaceful, more calm, more present, more satisfied with what I have—
sentences.chinese: 我发现，随着自己变得更幸福——“幸福”这个词可能说得太大了，准确地说，是更平静、更从容、更专注当下，也更满足于已有的一切——
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: I still want to do things, I just want to do bigger things.
sentences.chinese: 我还是想做事，只是想做更大的事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: I want to do things that are more pure, more aligned with what I think needs to be done and what I can uniquely do.
sentences.chinese: 我想做更纯粹的事：既符合我认为值得去做的事，也能发挥我独有的能力。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: So in that sense I think that being happier can actually make you more successful, but your definition of success will likely change along the way.
sentences.chinese: 所以从这个角度看，更幸福反而可能让你更成功；只是一路走来，你对“成功”的定义大概也会改变。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: Is that a realization you think you could have gotten to had you not had some success in the first place?
sentences.chinese: 你觉得，如果当初没有先取得一些成功，你还能领悟到这一点吗？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: At least for me, I always wanted to take the path of material success first.
sentences.chinese: 至少对我来说，我一直想先走物质成功这条路。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: I was not going to go be an ascetic and sit there and renounce everything. That just seems too unrealistic and too painful.
sentences.chinese: 我不会去当苦行僧，坐在那儿放弃一切。那太不现实，也太痛苦了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: In the story of Buddha, he starts out as a prince and then he sees that it’s all kind of meaningless because you’re still gonna get old and die,
sentences.chinese: 在佛陀的故事里，他一开始是个王子，后来他发现这一切都有点没意义，因为人终究还是会老、会死，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: and then he goes into the woods looking for something more.
sentences.chinese: 于是他走进森林，寻找物质生活之外更深一层的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: I’ll take the happy route that involves material success. Thank you.
sentences.chinese: 我还是选那条带着物质成功的快乐之路吧。谢谢。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 2 · Does Happiness Hinder Success?

sentences.english: I think it’s quicker in some ways. One of your insights is it’s far easier to achieve our material desires than it is to renounce them.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得从某些角度说，那样反而更快。你有个观点是：满足物质欲望，远比彻底放下这些欲望容易。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 3 · The Path to Freedom

sentences.english: It depends on the person, but I think you have to try that path. If you want something, go get it.
sentences.chinese: 这因人而异，但我觉得你得走一走那条路。想要什么，就去争取。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 3 · The Path to Freedom

sentences.english: I quipped that the reason to win the game is to be free of it,
sentences.chinese: 我曾半开玩笑地说：赢得一场游戏，最终是为了不再受这场游戏束缚。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 3 · The Path to Freedom

sentences.english: so you play the games, you win the games, and then hopefully, you get bored of the games.
sentences.chinese: 所以你先参与这些游戏，再设法赢下来；等赢过之后，希望你就不再那么迷恋它们了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 3 · The Path to Freedom

sentences.english: You don’t wanna just keep looping on the same game over and over,
sentences.chinese: 你不会想一直在同一个游戏里一遍又一遍地打转，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 3 · The Path to Freedom

sentences.english: although a lot of these games are very enticing and have many levels and are relatively open-ended.
sentences.chinese: 虽然很多这类游戏都非常诱人，关卡很多，而且相对开放，没有固定的结局。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 3 · The Path to Freedom

sentences.english: Then you become free of the game, in the sense that you’re no longer trying to win it—you know you can win it—
sentences.chinese: 到那时，你才真正摆脱了这场游戏的束缚：你不再非赢不可，因为你已经知道自己有能力赢。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 3 · The Path to Freedom

sentences.english: and either you move to a different game or you play the game for the sheer joy of it.
sentences.chinese: 接下来，你要么换一场游戏，要么纯粹因为享受过程而继续玩。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 3 · The Path to Freedom

sentences.english: Another one of yours: most of the gains in life come from suffering in the short term so you can get paid in the long term.
sentences.chinese: 人生中大部分收获，都来自愿意先承受短期的不舒服，换取长期的回报。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: That’s classic. That’s the marshmallow test on a daily basis.
sentences.chinese: 这很经典，就是每天都在做的棉花糖实验。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: But there’s an interesting challenge where I think people need to avoid becoming a suffering addict,
sentences.chinese: 但这里有个值得警惕的问题：我觉得人要避免对“吃苦”本身上瘾。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: sort of using suffering as the proxy for progress as opposed to the outcome of the suffering. Right?
sentences.chinese: 也就是把“我吃了多少苦”当作自己在进步的证明，却不去看这些苦究竟带来了什么结果，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: It’s like, I was in pain not eating the marshmallow. I was in pain doing this work.
sentences.chinese: 就好像：我忍着没吃棉花糖，好痛苦；我做这份工作，好痛苦。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: I have attached well-being and satisfaction to pain, not to what the pain gets me on the other side of it.
sentences.chinese: 我把幸福感和满足感寄托在“受苦”这件事本身，而不是受苦之后真正获得的东西上。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: If you define pain as physical pain, then it’s a real thing, it happens, and you can’t ignore it, but that’s not what we mean by suffering.
sentences.chinese: 如果把痛苦定义为身体上的疼痛，那它是真实存在的，会发生，你没法无视它，但我们说的“受苦”不是这个意思。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: Suffering is mostly mental anguish and mental pain, and it just means you don’t wanna do the task at hand.
sentences.chinese: 这里说的受苦，主要是心理上的煎熬：眼前有件事要做，而你心里抗拒做它。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: If you were fine doing the task at hand then you wouldn’t be suffering,
sentences.chinese: 如果你乐意做眼前的事，你就不会觉得受苦，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: and then the question is what’s more effective: to suffer along the way or just to interpret it in a way that it’s not suffering?
sentences.chinese: 那么问题来了：哪种方式更有效？一路咬牙忍受，还是换一种理解方式，让这段经历不再被你感受为痛苦？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: You hear from a lot of successful people, they look back and they say, “Oh the journey was the fun part.”
sentences.chinese: 你会听到很多成功人士回头看时说：“哦，其实过程才是最有趣的部分。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: That was actually the entertaining part and I should have enjoyed it more.
sentences.chinese: 那其实才是最好玩的部分，我当时应该更享受它。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: It’s a common regret.
sentences.chinese: 这是很常见的遗憾。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 4 · Suffering and Progress

sentences.english: There’s a little thought exercise I like to do which is,
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢做一个小小的思维练习，就是，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: you can go back into your own life and try to put yourself in the exact position you were in five years ago, ten years ago, fifteen years ago, twenty years ago.
sentences.chinese: 试着在脑海里回到五年、十年、十五年甚至二十年前，把自己重新放进当时的处境。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: You try to remember who was I with, what was I doing, what was I feeling, what were my emotions, what were my objectives,
sentences.chinese: 你试着回想：我当时和谁在一起，我在做什么，我有什么感受，我的情绪是什么，我的目标是什么，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: and really try to transport yourself back and see if there’s any advice you’d give yourself, anything you’d do differently.
sentences.chinese: 尽可能让自己重新回到那个时刻，再想想：你会给当时的自己什么建议？有什么事会换一种做法？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: Now you don’t have new information, don’t pretend you could have gone back and bought a stock or bought Bitcoin or whatever,
sentences.chinese: 但要记住，你不能带着未来才知道的信息回去。别假设自己能提前买对股票或比特币之类的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: but just knowing what you know now in terms of your temperament and a little bit of age-related experience, how would you have done things differently?
sentences.chinese: 你只能带着如今对自己性格的认识，以及这些年积累的一点人生经验，想想当时会怎样处理那些事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: I think it’s a worthwhile exercise to do.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得这是个值得做的练习。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: For me, I would have done everything the same except I would have done it with less anger, less emotion, less internal suffering because that was optional. It wasn’t necessary.
sentences.chinese: 对我来说，事情本身我大概都会照样做，只是不会带着那么多愤怒、情绪和内心煎熬，因为那些痛苦其实没必要。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: And I would argue that someone who can do the job at least peacefully, but maybe happily, is gonna be more effective than someone who has unnecessary emotional turmoil.
sentences.chinese: 我会说，一个人哪怕只是平静地、最好是开心地把事情做好，也会比一个带着不必要情绪起伏的人更有效率。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: Well, you end up with a series of miserable successes, right?
sentences.chinese: 那样一来，你得到的可能只是一连串让自己痛苦的“成功”，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: The outcome may have been the same, but the entire experience of getting there…
sentences.chinese: 结果也许一样，但到达那里的整个过程……
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 5 · Learning from Your Past Self

sentences.english: And the journey is not only the reward, the journey is the only thing there is.
sentences.chinese: 而且过程不只是通往回报的路；我们真正拥有的，其实只有这个过程。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: Even success, it’s human nature to bank it very quickly, right,
sentences.chinese: 即使取得了成功，人也很容易迅速把它当成既成事实，然后习以为常，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: because the normal loop that we run through is you sit around, you’re bored, then you want something,
sentences.chinese: 因为我们通常走的循环是：你闲坐着，觉得无聊，然后你想要某样东西，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: then when you want something you decide you’re not gonna be happy until you get that thing,
sentences.chinese: 接着一旦想要了，你就认定得到它之前你不会开心，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: then you start your bout of suffering or anticipation while you strive to get that thing.
sentences.chinese: 于是，在努力得到它的那段时间里，你开始经历一阵阵煎熬，或者充满期待的等待。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: If you get that thing then you get used to it, and then you get bored again,
sentences.chinese: 如果你得到了，你就会习惯它，然后又开始无聊，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: then a few months later you want something else, and if you don’t get it then you’re unhappy for a bit, and then you get over it then you want something else.
sentences.chinese: 然后过几个月你又想要别的东西，如果没得到，你会难过一阵子，然后走出来，接着又想要别的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: That’s the normal cycle. So whether you’re happy or unhappy at the end, it tends not to last.
sentences.chinese: 这就是常见的循环。所以不管你最后是开心还是不开心，那种感觉往往都不会持久。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: Now I don’t wanna be glib and say that there’s no point in making money or being successful.
sentences.chinese: 不过我也不想轻率地说，赚钱或取得成功毫无意义。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: There absolutely is—money solves all your money problems, so it is good to have money.
sentences.chinese: 当然有意义——钱能解决你所有跟钱有关的问题，所以有钱是好事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: That said, there are those stories, I don’t know if you’ve seen those studies, I don’t know how real these are, a lot of these psych studies don’t replicate,
sentences.chinese: 话虽如此，有那么些说法，我不知道你有没有看过那些研究，我也不知道它们有多可信，很多心理学研究都没法复现，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: but it’s a fun little study that shows that people who break their back and people who win the lottery are back to their baseline happiness two years later.
sentences.chinese: 不过有个挺有意思的研究说法：遭遇严重脊椎损伤的人和中彩票的人，过了两年，幸福感都会回到各自原来的基准水平。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: Again, don’t know if that’s entirely true. I think money can buy you happiness if you earned it,
sentences.chinese: 再说一次，我不知道那是不是完全正确。我觉得如果钱是你自己挣来的，它是能买到幸福的，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: because then along the way you have both pride and confidence in yourself, and you have a sense of accomplishment,
sentences.chinese: 因为这一路上你会对自己既有自豪感又有自信，而且你会有一种成就感，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: and you set out to do something and you were right, so I’ll bet that lingers, and then as I said, it solves your money problems.
sentences.chinese: 你决定去做一件事，后来证明自己的判断是对的。我猜那份成就感会持续一阵子；而且，钱确实能解决经济上的问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: So I don’t want to be too glib about it, but I would say in general, this loop that we run through of desire, dopamine, fulfillment, unfulfillment—you have to enjoy the journey.
sentences.chinese: 所以我不想把这件事说得太简单。但总体而言，我们不断经历“想要—多巴胺—满足—再次不满足”的循环，关键是要学会享受过程。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: The journey is all there is. Ninety-nine percent of your time is spent on the journey, so what kind of a journey is it if you’re not going to enjoy it?
sentences.chinese: 过程就是一切。你百分之九十九的时间都花在过程上，所以如果你不打算享受它，那这算什么样的过程呢？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 6 · The Journey Is All There Is

sentences.english: How do you shortcut that desire contract?
sentences.chinese: 怎样才能绕过这种“欲望契约”——也就是“得不到就不允许自己快乐”的约定？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 7 · Managing Desires

sentences.english: You could focus, you could decide that I don’t want most things.
sentences.chinese: 你可以专注，你可以决定：大多数东西我都不想要。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 7 · Managing Desires

sentences.english: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything,
sentences.chinese: 我觉得，我们有很多其实没必要的欲望，是在生活中不知不觉沾染来的；我们对什么都想发表意见，对什么都想评头论足。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 7 · Managing Desires

sentences.english: so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.
sentences.chinese: 只要意识到这些欲望正是不幸福的来源，你就会更谨慎地选择自己究竟要追求什么。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 7 · Managing Desires

sentences.english: And frankly if you want to be successful, you have to be choosy about your desires, you have to focus.
sentences.chinese: 而且说真的，如果你想有所成就，就必须有所取舍，认真选择自己的欲望，把精力集中在重要的事情上。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 7 · Managing Desires

sentences.english: You can’t be great at everything. You’re just going to waste your energy and waste your time.
sentences.chinese: 你不可能样样都做得很好。那样你只会浪费精力，浪费时间。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 7 · Managing Desires

sentences.english: Is fame a worthwhile goal?
sentences.chinese: 名气是个值得追求的目标吗？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: It gets you invited to better parties. It gets you to better restaurants.
sentences.chinese: 它能让你被邀请去更好的派对，能让你进更好的餐厅。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: Fame is this funny thing where a lot of people know you, but you don’t know them, and it does get you put on the pedestal.
sentences.chinese: 名气很奇妙：很多人认识你，你却不认识他们；而且别人确实会把你捧得很高。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: It can get you what you want at distance, so I wouldn’t say it’s worthless.
sentences.chinese: 名气甚至能让你不用亲自出面，就获得一些想要的东西，所以我不会说它毫无价值。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: Obviously people want it for a reason, it’s high status so it attracts the opposite sex, especially for men it attracts women.
sentences.chinese: 显然人们想要它是有原因的：它代表高地位，所以能吸引异性，尤其对男人来说，它能吸引女人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: That said, it is high cost. It means you have no privacy, you do have weirdos and lunatics,
sentences.chinese: 话虽如此，它的代价也很高。它意味着你没有隐私，你确实会碰到怪人和疯子，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: you do get hit up a lot for weird things, and you’re on a stage so you’re forced to perform.
sentences.chinese: 你会经常被陌生人为了各种奇怪的事情找上门；而且仿佛一直站在舞台上，不得不维持某种公众形象。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: You’re forced to be consistent with your past proclamations and actions, and you’re gonna have haters and all that nonsense.
sentences.chinese: 你会被迫与自己过去公开发表的言论和做过的事保持一致，还得面对讨厌你的人和各种麻烦。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: But the fact that we do it, the fact that we all seem to want it means that it would be disingenuous to say, “Oh no, no, I’m famous, but you don’t wanna be.”
sentences.chinese: 但既然我们确实都在追逐名气，也似乎都想拥有它，那么一个已经出名的人却说“哎呀，你可千万别出名”，听起来就不太真诚。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: That said, I think fame, like anything else, is best produced as a byproduct of something potentially more worthwhile.
sentences.chinese: 不过我觉得，名气和其他东西一样，最好是做了某件可能更有价值的事之后，自然产生的副产品。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: Wanting to be famous and craving to be famous and being famous for being famous, these are sort of traps.
sentences.chinese: 想出名、渴望出名、因为出名而出名，这些都算是陷阱。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: Fame for fame’s sake.
sentences.chinese: 为了出名而出名。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: Yeah exactly, so it’s better that it’s earned fame.
sentences.chinese: 对，就是这样。所以最好是凭自己真正做出的事情赢得名声。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: For example, earned respect in the tribe is you do things that are good for the tribe.
sentences.chinese: 比如说，在部落里挣来的尊重，就是你做了对部落有益的事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: Who are the most famous people in human history? There are people who sort of transcended the self, the Buddhas and the Jesuses and the Mohammads of the world.
sentences.chinese: 人类历史上最有名的人是谁？是那些某种程度上超越了自我的人，像佛陀、耶稣、穆罕默德这些人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: Who else is famous? The artists are famous—art lasts for a long time. The scientists are famous—they discover things.
sentences.chinese: 还有谁出名？艺术家出名——艺术能流传很久。科学家出名——他们发现新东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: The conquerors are famous, presumably because they conquered for their tribe, was someone that they were fighting for.
sentences.chinese: 征服者出名，大概是因为他们是为自己的部落去征服的，是在为某些人而战。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: So generally the higher up you rise by doing things for greater and greater groups of people, even though it may be considered tyrannical or negative,
sentences.chinese: 一般来说，你做的事惠及的人越多，你的影响力就可能越大——即使有些行为也可能被人看作专横甚至有害。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: like Genghis Khan is famous, but to the Mongols he was doing good, to the rest of them not so much.
sentences.chinese: 比如成吉思汗很有名，对蒙古人来说他在做好事，对其他人来说就没那么好了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: The higher level you’re operating at, the more people you’re taking care of, the more you sort of earn respect and fame, and I think those are good reasons to be famous.
sentences.chinese: 你运作的层级越高，你照顾的人越多，你就越能挣得尊重和名气，我觉得这些都是出名的好理由。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: If fame is empty, if you’re famous just because your name showed up in a lot of places or your face showed up in a lot of places, then that’s a hollow fame
sentences.chinese: 如果名气是空的，如果你出名只是因为你的名字或者你的脸在很多地方出现过，那就是一种空洞的名气，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: and I think deep down you will know that and so it’ll be fragile and you’ll always be afraid of losing it and then you’ll be forced to perform.
sentences.chinese: 而且我觉得你内心深处会知道这一点，所以它会很脆弱，你会一直害怕失去它，然后你就不得不一直表演。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: So the kind of fame that pure actors and celebrities have, I wouldn’t want, but the kind of fame that’s earned because you did something useful, why dodge that?
sentences.chinese: 所以，那种只是靠曝光获得的明星式名气，我并不向往；但如果名气是因为你做了有用的事而赢来的，又何必拒绝呢？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 8 · Is Fame Worth It?

sentences.english: No, you can’t.
sentences.chinese: 不，你做不到。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 9 · Changing Your Mind

sentences.english: There’s a challenge I think, especially if people make very loud public proclamations about things.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得这里有个难处，尤其是一个人曾经非常高调地公开表明某种立场的时候。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 9 · Changing Your Mind

sentences.english: You mentioned there about, you’re almost a hostage to the things that you used to say.
sentences.chinese: 你刚才提到，一个人几乎会被自己过去说过的话绑住，难以脱身。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 9 · Changing Your Mind

sentences.english: Being able to update your opinions and change your mind looks very similar to the internet as hypocrisy does.
sentences.chinese: 在互联网上，一个人更新观点、改变主意，看起来常常跟“前后不一、虚伪”没什么区别。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 9 · Changing Your Mind

sentences.english: The difference between me saying something in the past and saying something different now is perhaps I’ve learned, perhaps I’ve updated my beliefs.
sentences.chinese: 我过去说一套、现在说另一套，也许只是因为我后来学到了新东西，更新了自己的看法。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 9 · Changing Your Mind

sentences.english: But so few people do it in a legitimate way.
sentences.chinese: 但真正有充分理由、坦诚地改变立场的人，其实很少。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 9 · Changing Your Mind

sentences.english: I think that the grifter shill—you’d see this is the smoking gun that shows that he didn’t really believe that thing all along.
sentences.chinese: 至于那些靠忽悠或替人站台谋利的人，这种前后矛盾就可能成为一个明显的证据：他们从一开始就没真心相信自己说的那套。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 9 · Changing Your Mind

sentences.english: I went to a retreat in LA a couple of years ago, and there was a guy that I used to follow, a big business and productivity advice content creator, really successful,
sentences.chinese: 几年前我去洛杉矶参加了一个静修营，那里有个我以前关注过的人，一个做商业和效率建议的大内容创作者，非常成功，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 9 · Changing Your Mind

sentences.english: and he just totally stepped back from everything, went monk mode and focused on his business.
sentences.chinese: 后来他几乎退出了原来那些公开活动，进入一种“闭关专注”的状态，把心思放回自己的生意上。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 9 · Changing Your Mind

sentences.english: I asked him why, and he said, “I started feeling like I had to live up to in private the things that I was saying in public.”
sentences.chinese: 我问他为什么，他说：“我开始觉得，既然我在公开场合说了那些话，那私底下也应该真正做到。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: It’s what Emerson said, “Foolish consistency is the hobgoblin of little minds.”
sentences.chinese: 就像爱默生说的：“愚蠢地坚持前后一致，是思想狭隘之人的心魔。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: But essentially, look, all learning is error correction.
sentences.chinese: 但本质上，你看，所有的学习都是纠错。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: Every knowledge creation system works through making guesses and correcting errors.
sentences.chinese: 每一个创造知识的系统，都是靠猜测和纠正错误来运作的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: So by definition, if you’re learning, you’re going to be wrong most of the time and you’ll be updating your priors.
sentences.chinese: 所以，从学习本身的定义来看，只要你还在学习，就难免经常判断错，也会不断根据新信息修正原先的判断。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: For example, I did this Joe Rogan podcast, I don’t know, eight or nine years ago, and people will call out like the one thing that didn’t turn out to be correct.
sentences.chinese: 比如，我大概八九年前参加过一期 Joe Rogan 的播客，后来人们就会专门挑出其中那一件最终被证明不正确的事来说。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: They just beat on it because it helps them in their mind raise their status a little bit – “I caught him in an error.”
sentences.chinese: 他们就揪着不放，因为在他们心里这能让自己的地位提高一点——“我抓到他犯错了。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: If you catch someone in a blatant lie where they believe one thing and say another, that’s legit – that’s a character flaw.
sentences.chinese: 如果你抓到某人公然撒谎，心里信一套、嘴上说一套，那批评是合理的——那是人品缺陷。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: They shouldn’t be lying.
sentences.chinese: 他们不该撒谎。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: But on the other hand, if they just made a guess at something and they got it wrong.
sentences.chinese: 但另一方面，如果他们只是对某件事做了猜测，结果猜错了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: Mostly it’s about the AI AGI thing, and I think I’m still right about that, but it’s a different story.
sentences.chinese: 主要是关于 AI、AGI 那件事，我觉得我在这点上还是对的，不过那是另一回事了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: People who think we have achieved AGI just fail a Turing test from their side.
sentences.chinese: 那些觉得我们已经实现 AGI 的人，在我看来反倒是他们自己没通过图灵测试。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: It’s funny how people latch onto single proclamations, but the reality is all of us are dynamical systems.
sentences.chinese: 有意思的是，人们会死抓住某一句表态不放，但现实是，我们每个人都是不断变化的动态系统。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: We’re always changing, always learning, always growing, and hopefully we’re correcting errors.
sentences.chinese: 我们一直在变、一直在学、一直在成长，希望也一直在纠正错误。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: But what you don’t want to be doing is lying in public because you’re trying to look good.
sentences.chinese: 但你不该做的，是为了让自己显得好而在公开场合撒谎。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: I think people can smell that.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得大家其实能察觉出来。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: What this world really lacks right now is authenticity, because everybody wants something.
sentences.chinese: 现在这个世界真正缺少的是真诚，因为每个人都想要点什么。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: They want to be seen as something, they want to be something that they’re not.
sentences.chinese: 他们想被看作某种人，想成为自己本来不是的样子。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: So you catch a lot of people saying things that they don’t really believe, and I think people are very sensitive to that.
sentences.chinese: 所以你会发现很多人说着自己并不真信的话，我觉得大家对此非常敏感。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: Bullshit radars have become hypersensitized to try and work out whether or not this person means the thing that they’re saying.
sentences.chinese: 人们识别虚假和不真诚言论的“雷达”已经变得异常敏感，总想弄清楚一个人说的话到底是不是真心的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: Most of us are wrong most of the time, especially in any new endeavor.
sentences.chinese: 我们大多数人大部分时候都是错的，尤其是在做任何新尝试的时候。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: There’s a difference between being wrong and disingenuous though.
sentences.chinese: 不过，说错了和明知不真诚却故意那样说，是两回事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: I think that’s the big difference.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得这就是最大的区别。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: If someone is wrong, no big deal, as long as they have a genuine reason for saying what they’re saying or believing what they’re believing.
sentences.chinese: 一个人说错了也没什么大不了，只要他确实有真诚的理由，才会说那些话、相信那些事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: But if they are lying to elevate their status or their appearance or to live up to some expectation, that’s the mistake.
sentences.chinese: 但如果他们撒谎是为了抬高自己的地位、形象，或者为了符合某种期待，那就错了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: And that’s a mistake not just for the listener, it's a mistake for themselves, because then you’re going to get trapped in a hall of mirrors.
sentences.chinese: 而且这不只是误导听众，对说话的人自己也有害，因为他最后会困在一个真假难辨、不断自我欺骗的“镜子迷宫”里。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: You yourself are going to be consistent with your past proclamations, so if you’re lying to others, you’re going to be lying to yourself.
sentences.chinese: 你自己会努力和过去的表态保持一致，所以如果你对别人撒谎，你也会对自己撒谎。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: You’re puppeted by a person that you are not even.
sentences.chinese: 你就像被一个根本不是真实自己的虚构形象牵着走。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: It’s like, what was the line?
sentences.chinese: 就像，那句话是怎么说的来着？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: You’re basically trying to impress people who don’t care about you.
sentences.chinese: 说白了，你一直在努力让那些根本不在乎你的人对你刮目相看。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: And they don’t like the real you, and if they saw the real you, they wouldn’t care.
sentences.chinese: 他们并不喜欢真实的你，就算看到了真实的你，他们也不会在乎。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: And the people who would like the real you don’t get to see the real you, so they pass you by.
sentences.chinese: 而那些会喜欢真实的你的人，却看不到真实的你，于是就和你擦肩而过。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: You only want the respect of the very, very few people that you respect.
sentences.chinese: 你只需要得到极少数你尊重的人的尊重。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: Trying to demand respect from the masses is a fool’s errand.
sentences.chinese: 想强求所有普通大众都尊重你，根本是一件注定徒劳的事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 10 · Living Authentically

sentences.english: Status games, the allure of accruing, whether it’s fame, actual fame, or just the competition comparison trap, it’s always there.
sentences.chinese: 地位游戏——人总会被不断积累东西的诱惑吸引：不管是名气、真正的知名度，还是陷入竞争和攀比的圈套。这种诱惑始终都在。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: There’s a real draw of being swayed by social approval, but how should people learn to get less distracted by status games in that way?
sentences.chinese: 被社会认可牵着走，这件事本身就很有诱惑力；可人该怎么学会，别那么容易被这种地位游戏分心呢？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: I think it just helps to see that status games don’t matter as much as they used to.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得，看清地位游戏已经不像过去那么重要，会很有帮助。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: In old society, let’s go back to hunter-gatherer times, there was no such thing as wealth – you just had what you could carry.
sentences.chinese: 回到很久以前的狩猎采集时代，那时候还谈不上我们今天理解的那种财富——你能拥有的，基本就是自己带得走的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: There was no stored wealth, so wealth creation games didn’t exist.
sentences.chinese: 当时没有多少能长期储存的财富，所以也谈不上通过创造财富来竞争。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: All that existed was status games.
sentences.chinese: 存在的只有地位游戏。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: If you were high status, then you got what little was available first, but even back then you had to earn your status by taking care of the tribe.
sentences.chinese: 如果你地位高，就能先拿到那一点点可用的东西，但即使在那时，你也得靠照顾部落来赢得地位。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Now we have wealth creation where you can actually create a product or a service.
sentences.chinese: 现在我们有了财富创造，你真的可以创造一个产品或一项服务。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: You can scale that product or service and you can provide abundance for a lot of people, and that’s not zero-sum, that’s a positive-sum game.
sentences.chinese: 你可以把产品或服务做大，让更多人受益。这不是零和游戏，而是大家都可能得到更多的正和游戏。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: I can be wealthy, you can be wealthy, we can create things together.
sentences.chinese: 我可以富有，你也可以富有，我们可以一起创造东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: And clearly since we are all collectively far, far wealthier than we were in hunter-gatherer times, wealth creation is positive.
sentences.chinese: 很明显，和狩猎采集时代相比，我们所有人加起来拥有的财富已经多得多了。这说明财富是可以被创造出来的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: But status is limited.
sentences.chinese: 但地位是有限的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: There’s limited status to go around.
sentences.chinese: 地位就那么多，不够大家分。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: It’s a ranking ladder, it’s a hierarchy, and so if one person rises in status, somebody else has to lower in status.
sentences.chinese: 地位就像一张排名表，有高有低。所以一个人的排名往上升，就意味着另一个人的相对排名要下降。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Now you can have multiple kinds of status, so you can expand some kinds of status,
sentences.chinese: 当然，地位可以有很多种，所以有些种类的地位可以扩大，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: but it’s not like wealth creation where it can go infinitely, where we can all be living in the stars and moon bases or Mars colonies.
sentences.chinese: 但地位不像财富那样有不断扩大的空间。财富可以让人类走得更远，甚至有一天住进月球基地或火星聚居地。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Just realize the status games are inherently limited.
sentences.chinese: 只要意识到，地位游戏天生就是有限的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: They’re always combative.
sentences.chinese: 它们总是带着对抗性。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: They always require direct combat, whereas wealth creation games can be just you creating products – you don’t have to fight anybody else.
sentences.chinese: 地位竞争总得有人跟你争高下；但创造财富可以只是你做出有用的产品，不一定非得打败别人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Yes, in the marketplace your product has to succeed,
sentences.chinese: 没错，在市场上你的产品必须成功，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: but that’s not quite the same as invective against other people or being angry with other people or feeling pushed down or pushed up or having a beef with somebody.
sentences.chinese: 但产品在市场上成功，跟骂别人、怨恨别人、觉得自己被人压了一头或捧了一把，或者跟谁有过节，不是一回事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: So I would argue that wealth creation games are both more pleasant, they’re positive-sum, and they actually have concrete material returns.
sentences.chinese: 所以我认为，创造财富不仅更让人愉快，而且能让整体的财富增加，还能带来实实在在的物质回报。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: If you have more money, you can buy more.
sentences.chinese: 钱多了，你就能买更多。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Show me where you can exchange your status at the bank.
sentences.chinese: 你倒是说说看，哪家银行能让你把社会地位直接换成钱？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Exactly, it’s vague and fuzzy.
sentences.chinese: 没错，它模糊又说不清。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Now, you see people get rich, they have money, what do they want?
sentences.chinese: 你看，人们变富了，有钱了，他们想要什么？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: They want status, so they go to Hollywood, start starring in movies, they donate to non-profits, they go to Cannes or Davos, and they start trying to trade the money for status.
sentences.chinese: 他们有了钱，又想获得社会地位，于是去好莱坞演电影、给非营利组织捐款、出入戛纳和达沃斯，试着拿钱换名望。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: People always want what they don’t have, and we are evolutionarily hardwired for status because as I said, wealth creation didn’t really exist until the agricultural revolution when you could store grain.
sentences.chinese: 人总想得到自己还没有的东西。而我们对地位的渴望，是漫长进化过程中形成的；因为就像我说的，直到农业革命让人能储存粮食，创造财富这件事才真正开始出现。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Then the industrial revolution took it to another level and now the information age is taking it to yet another level.
sentences.chinese: 后来工业革命把它提升到了另一个层次，现在信息时代又把它推向了更高的层次。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: There’s never been an easier time to make money.
sentences.chinese: 赚钱从来没有像现在这么容易过。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Yes, it’s still hard, but there’s never been an easier time to create wealth, because there’s so much leverage out there, there’s so much opportunity.
sentences.chinese: 没错，创造财富仍然不容易，但现在比过去任何时候都更有机会，因为有太多能放大个人努力的工具，也有太多机会。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: You still have to go find it, it’s not easy, it’s not gonna fall on your lap and you have to learn something and know something and do something interesting,
sentences.chinese: 你还是得自己去找，这不容易，机会不会自己掉到你怀里，你得学点东西、懂点东西、做点有意思的事，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: but nevertheless it’s possible to many more people.
sentences.chinese: 但即便如此，今天还是有比过去多得多的人有机会做到。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: A few hundred years ago you were born a serf, you were gonna die a serf, there was almost no way out of that.
sentences.chinese: 几百年前，你生来是农奴，死的时候也还是农奴，几乎没有出路。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: That’s changed, and so I would argue that you’re better off focusing on wealth games than status games.
sentences.chinese: 时代已经变了。所以我的建议是，与其把精力放在争地位上，不如放在创造财富上。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: If you’re trying to build up, for example, your following on a social network and get famous and then get rich off of being famous,
sentences.chinese: 比如说，如果你想在社交网络上积累粉丝，先出名，再靠名气发财，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: that’s a much harder path than getting rich first, and then go for your fame afterwards would be my advice.
sentences.chinese: 那条路比先变富、之后再去追求名气要难得多，这是我的建议。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: A lot of people do that, as you said.
sentences.chinese: 正如你说的，很多人都这么做。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: It’s funny how people who have achieved such a level of wealth – you think why do you need the status, given that most people use status to then try and cash in to achieve wealth?
sentences.chinese: 有意思的是，有些人明明已经非常有钱了，你就会想：既然大多数人都是先争取名望、再把名望变成财富，那这些人为什么还要追求地位呢？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: If you’ve achieved “fuck you money” already, if you’re post-money or asset-heavy as it’s known, why are you trying to go in the other direction?
sentences.chinese: 如果你已经有足够的钱，可以不看任何人的脸色；如果你已经过了需要为钱奔波的阶段，或者手里有很多资产，为什么还要反过来追逐地位呢？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: As you said, because we’ve got an illustrious history biologically of wanting status, and wealth is kind of novel.
sentences.chinese: 就像你说的，从生物进化的角度看，人类追求地位的历史非常悠久，而创造财富相对来说还是新事物。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Wealth is something that you have to understand more intellectually.
sentences.chinese: 财富这件事，需要你更多地靠理性思考才能真正理解。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Yeah, there’s a physical component, more food, more survival,
sentences.chinese: 是的，它有物质层面的部分，更多食物、更容易生存，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: but to truly understand the effects and the powers and the abilities and limitations, and the advantages and disadvantages of wealth, you have to use your neocortex a lot more.
sentences.chinese: 但要真正理解财富能带来什么、做不到什么，以及它的各种利弊，你就得更多地运用理性思考能力。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Does that mean the reason to play the game is to win the game and be done with it?
sentences.chinese: 你的意思是，我们参与这场游戏，就是为了赢下来，然后不再被它牵着走吗？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Is it harder to win and be done with for status than it is for wealth?
sentences.chinese: 相比财富，要在地位竞争中赢到一个可以停下来的程度，是不是更难？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: That’s a good observation, I hadn’t thought that through, but you’re right.
sentences.chinese: 这个观察很到位，我之前没想透，但你说得对。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: I think people will always want more status, but I think you can be satisfied at a certain level of wealth.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得人们永远会想要更多地位，但财富到了一定程度，你是可以满足的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Well, you always have this sort of sense, and this is what leaderboards are.
sentences.chinese: 嗯，你总会有这种感觉，这就是排行榜的本质。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: And it is zero-sum.
sentences.chinese: 而且它是零和的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: And it is, I guess, you know, the Forbes richest people on the planet.
sentences.chinese: 我想也就是，你知道的，福布斯全球富豪榜那种。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: That one’s harder to climb the ladder on,
sentences.chinese: 在那个榜单上想往上爬就更难了，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: but the fact that, for example, iTunes and YouTube can put you in competition against your contemporaries every single day, and make you go up and down and show you likes and comments and ratings.
sentences.chinese: 可问题是，像 iTunes 和 YouTube 这样的平台，每天都能让你跟同行比高低，让排名不断升降，还不断给你看点赞、评论和评分。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: This is how much you fell, this is how much you’re up.
sentences.chinese: 你掉了多少名，你又涨了多少名。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: They’ll keep you running on that treadmill forever.
sentences.chinese: 它们会让你一直困在这种永远跑不完的竞争里。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Jimmy Carr has this cool idea where he says trajectory is more important than position.
sentences.chinese: Jimmy Carr 有个很有意思的观点：比起你现在排在哪里，更重要的是你正在往哪个方向走。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: So, if you are number one hundred and one in the world, but last year you were number two hundred,
sentences.chinese: 比如，如果你现在世界排名第一百零一，但去年排第两百，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: versus you’re number two in the world, but last year you were number one, there is this sense of the deceleration is very, very tangible.
sentences.chinese: 而另一个人虽然排世界第二，去年却是第一。即使排名仍然很高，那种自己正在往下掉的感觉也会非常强烈。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: And again it goes back to evolution.
sentences.chinese: 这又回到了进化。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Something that is bleeding eventually dies, unless you stop the bleeding, so you’re hardwired not to lose what you have.
sentences.chinese: 一个生命如果一直失血，最终就会死，除非及时止血。所以从本能上，我们特别害怕失去已经拥有的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: Because we evolved in conditions where we’re so close to just not surviving, you don’t want to give anything up.
sentences.chinese: 因为我们是在差一点就活不下去的条件下进化来的，所以你什么都不想放弃。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: It’s hardwired into us to not give anything up.
sentences.chinese: 不愿意放弃已有的东西，几乎成了我们与生俱来的本能。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: So you grip tightly?
sentences.chinese: 所以你会紧紧抓住不放？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 11 · Status Games vs. Wealth Creation

sentences.english: The worst outcome in the world is not having self-esteem.
sentences.chinese: 世界上最糟糕的结果，就是一个人没有自尊。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: It’s a tough one.
sentences.chinese: 这个问题很难。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: I look at the people who don’t like themselves and that’s the toughest slot because they’re always wrestling with themselves.
sentences.chinese: 我观察那些不喜欢自己的人，发现他们处在最难熬的境地，因为他们总是在跟自己较劲。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: It’s hard enough to face the outside world, and no one’s going to like you more than you like yourself, so if you’re struggling with yourself then the outside world becomes an insurmountable challenge.
sentences.chinese: 面对外面的世界本来就够难了；而且，别人对你的喜欢，很难超过你自己对自己的喜欢。所以，如果你一直在跟自己过不去，外面的世界就会变成一个难以跨越的挑战。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: It’s hard to say why people have low self-esteem.
sentences.chinese: 很难说，人为什么会有这么低的自尊。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: It might be genetic, it might just be circumstantial.
sentences.chinese: 这可能和遗传有关，也可能只是当时的处境造成的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: A lot of times I think it’s because they just weren’t unconditionally loved as a child and that sort of seeps in at a deep core level, but self-esteem issues can be the most limiting.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得，很多时候是因为他们小时候没有得到无条件的爱；这种经历可能会慢慢渗到内心深处。不过，自尊方面的问题可能是最限制一个人的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: One interesting thought is that to some extent self-esteem is a reputation you have with yourself.
sentences.chinese: 有个有意思的想法是：在某种程度上，自尊就像你在自己心里给自己建立的声誉。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: You’re watching yourself at all times, you know what you’re doing and you have your own moral code.
sentences.chinese: 你一直都在观察自己；你知道自己做了什么，也有自己的一套道德准则。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: Everyone has a different moral code, but if you don’t live up to your own moral code, the same code that you hold others to, it will damage your self-esteem.
sentences.chinese: 每个人的道德准则都不一样。但如果你连自己定下的准则都做不到——也就是你拿来要求别人的那套准则——这就会伤害你的自尊。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: So perhaps one way to build up your self-esteem is to live up to your own code – very rigorously have one and then live up to it.
sentences.chinese: 所以，也许建立自尊的一种方式，就是按照自己的准则行事：先认真、严格地确立一套准则，再努力做到。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: Another way to raise your self-esteem might be to do things for others.
sentences.chinese: 另一个提升自尊的方法，也许是为别人做些事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: If I look back on my life and what are the moments that I’m actually proud of, they’re very far and few between.
sentences.chinese: 如果回顾我的人生，想想哪些时刻让我真正感到自豪，那样的时刻其实非常少。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: It’s not that often and it’s not the things you would expect – it’s not the material success, it’s not having learned this thing or that.
sentences.chinese: 真正让我自豪的时刻并不多，而且也不是你以为的那些事——不是物质上的成功，也不是学会了某个知识或技能。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: It’s when I made a sacrifice for somebody or something that I loved.
sentences.chinese: 而是那些我为自己爱的人或事做出牺牲的时刻。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: That’s when I’m actually, ironically, most proud.
sentences.chinese: 说来也有点讽刺，那些时刻反而让我最自豪。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: Now that’s through an explicit mental exercise, but I’ll bet you at some level I’m recording that implicitly.
sentences.chinese: 这是我有意识地做了一番思考后得出的结论；但我敢说，在某个层面上，我其实也一直在无意识地记下这些事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: So that tells me that even if I am not being loved, the way to create love is to give love, to express love through sacrifice and through duty.
sentences.chinese: 所以这让我想到：即使没有人爱我，创造爱的方式仍然是去给予爱，通过牺牲和承担责任来表达爱。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: And so I think doing things like that can build up your self-esteem really fast.
sentences.chinese: 所以我觉得，做这样的事能很快增强你的自尊。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: It’s interesting when you talk about sacrifice, because a lot of the time people say, “I sacrificed so much for my job.”
sentences.chinese: 你说到“牺牲”很有意思，因为很多人会说：“我为了工作牺牲了好多。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: It’s like, yeah, but that was you sacrificing something that you wanted less for something that you wanted more, as opposed to genuinely taking some sort of cost.
sentences.chinese: 这就像：你只是放弃了自己没那么想要的东西，换取更想要的东西；这和真正付出某种代价是不一样的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 12 · The Importance of Self-Esteem

sentences.english: And, yeah, I wonder whether if self-esteem is you adhering to your internal,
sentences.chinese: 嗯，我在想，如果自尊来自你坚持内心的价值观，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: your actions and your values aligning, even when it’s difficult or perhaps even more so when it’s difficult.
sentences.chinese: 让行动和价值观保持一致——哪怕这样做很难，甚至恰恰是在最难的时候更要坚持——那么……
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: I wonder whether there is a price that people who are more introspective, high integrity pay because you think, well,
sentences.chinese: 我在想，那些更善于自省、又特别看重原则的人，是不是要为此付出某种代价？因为你会觉得，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: you’ve got this heavier set of overheads that you need to pay in some way.
sentences.chinese: 他们仿佛背负着更多必须承担的成本。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: Well, if being ethical were profitable, everybody would do it, right?
sentences.chinese: 嗯，要是讲道德总能带来好处，那人人都会这么做，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: So, at some level it does involve a sacrifice, but that sacrifice can also be thought of as you’re thinking for the long term rather than the short term.
sentences.chinese: 所以，从某种程度上说，坚持道德确实意味着有所牺牲。但换个角度看，这种牺牲也可以理解为：你选择考虑长远，而不是只顾眼前。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: For example, the virtues are the set of beliefs that if everybody in society followed them as individuals, it would lead to win-win outcomes for everybody.
sentences.chinese: 比如，美德是一套行为信念：如果社会中的每个人都愿意遵循，最终就能让所有人受益，实现双赢。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: So if I am honest and you are honest, then we can do business more easily, we can interact more easily because we can trust each other.
sentences.chinese: 所以，如果你我都诚实，我们做生意、与人相处都会更容易，因为彼此可以信任。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: Even though there might be a few liars in the system, as long as there aren’t too many liars and too many cheaters,
sentences.chinese: 即使社会里难免有少数说谎或欺骗的人，只要这样的人不太多，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: a high trust society where everybody’s honest is better off, and I think a lot of the virtues work this way.
sentences.chinese: 一个以诚实和信任为基础的社会整体上仍会过得更好。我觉得很多美德都遵循这个道理。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: If I don’t go around sleeping with your wife and you don’t sleep with mine, and
sentences.chinese: 如果我不会到处去和别人的伴侣发生关系，你也不会这样对我；
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: if I don’t take all the food that’s at the table first and so on, then we all get along better and we can play win-win games.
sentences.chinese: 如果我不会抢先把桌上的食物全拿走，等等，那么大家就更容易和睦相处，也更能建立互利的合作关系。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 13 · The Price of Integrity

sentences.english: In game theory the most famous game is Prisoner’s Dilemma, but that’s all about everybody cheating and the Nash equilibrium, the stable equilibrium there is everybody cheats.
sentences.chinese: 在博弈论里，最著名的模型是“囚徒困境”。在纳瓦尔这里的描述中，双方都选择背叛，而纳什均衡——也就是各方都没有动力单方面改变策略的稳定状态——恰好就是双方都背叛。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: The only way you can play a win-win game is if you have long term iterated moves, but that’s not actually the most common game played in society.
sentences.chinese: 按照他的说法，要形成双赢，就需要长期、反复地互动；但他认为，社会里更常见的并不是这种模型。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: The most common game played is one called a stag hunt, where if we cooperate we can bring down a big stag and both have big dinners,
sentences.chinese: 他认为，更常见的是一种叫“猎鹿博弈”的情形：如果我们合作，就能猎到一头大鹿，大家都吃得很丰盛；
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: but if we don’t cooperate then we have to go hunt like rabbits and we each have small dinners.
sentences.chinese: 如果不合作，就只能各自去抓小兔子，最后每个人都只能吃上一点。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: That game has two stable equilibriums – one could be where we’re both hunting the rabbit, and one could be where we’re hunting the stag.
sentences.chinese: 这种博弈有两个稳定的均衡状态：一种是我们都去抓兔子，另一种是我们一起去猎鹿。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: So the high trust society is a more virtuous society where I can trust you to come hunt the stag with me and
sentences.chinese: 所以，一个高度互信的社会，也是一个更重视美德的社会：我能相信你会和我一起猎鹿，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: show up on time and do the work and divide it up properly.
sentences.chinese: 会准时出现、认真出力，最后也会公平分配成果。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: So you want to live in a system where everybody has their own set of virtues and follows them, and then we all win.
sentences.chinese: 因此，理想的环境是每个人都有自己认可的一套原则，而且真的会遵守。这样大家都能受益。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: But I would argue you don’t need to do that for sacrifice, you don’t need to do that for other people, you can do it just purely for yourself.
sentences.chinese: 但我认为，你不必把坚持原则理解成一种自我牺牲，也不必只是为了别人；你完全可以是为了自己而这样做。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: You will have higher self-esteem, you will attract other high virtue people.
sentences.chinese: 你会更尊重自己，也会吸引其他有原则的人来到身边。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: Would I go on a stag hunt with me?
sentences.chinese: “如果合作对象是我自己，我愿不愿意和这样的人一起去猎鹿？”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: Correct. Yeah, that’s right.
sentences.chinese: 没错，对，就是这个意思。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: If you’re the kind of person who long term signals ethics and virtues, then you’ll attract other people who are ethical and virtuous,
sentences.chinese: 如果你长期通过自己的行为表现出诚信和原则，你就会吸引同样正直的人；
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: whereas if you are a shark, you will eventually find yourself swimming entirely amongst sharks and that’s an unpleasant existence.
sentences.chinese: 反过来，如果你是个只想占别人便宜的“鲨鱼”，最后你会发现自己周围也全是这种人，而那样的生活并不好受。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: And this goes back to the equivalent of the marshmallow test.
sentences.chinese: 这又让人想到类似“棉花糖实验”的道理。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: The marshmallow test does not replicate – it got hit hard in the replication crisis recently, but it is about trading off the short term for the long term.
sentences.chinese: 不过，棉花糖实验的结果并没有在后续研究中稳定复现——在近年的“可重复性危机”中，它受到很大质疑。但这个例子想讨论的核心仍是：为了长期利益，愿意放弃多少眼前的好处。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: I think for a lot of these so-called virtues, there are long-term selfish reasons to be virtuous.
sentences.chinese: 我认为，很多所谓的美德，其实也有一种从长期来看对自己有利的理由，让你愿意做个有原则的人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 14 · Game Theory and Society

sentences.english: Yeah. Did you deal with self-doubt in the past? Is that something that was a hurdle for you to overcome?
sentences.chinese: 嗯。你过去有过自我怀疑吗？那曾经是你需要跨越的一道障碍吗？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: Yes and no. I think I dealt with self-doubt in the sense that, “Oh, I don’t know what I’m doing and I need to figure it out.”
sentences.chinese: 有，也没有。我确实会怀疑自己，意思是：“哦，我不知道自己在做什么，我得把它弄明白。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: But I didn’t doubt myself in the way of “somebody else knows better than me for me” or that “I’m an idiot” or “I’m not worthwhile” or anything like that.
sentences.chinese: 但我不会因此怀疑自己，认定“别人比我更懂什么对我好”，或者觉得“我是个白痴”“我没有价值”之类的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: I guess I had the benefit of I grew up with a lot of love, like the people around me love me unconditionally.
sentences.chinese: 我想我很幸运，从小被很多爱包围，身边的人都无条件地爱我。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: And so that just gave me a lot of confidence, not the kind of confidence that would say I have the answer,
sentences.chinese: 所以这给了我很大的信心——不是那种“我已经知道答案”的自信，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: but the kind of confidence that I will figure it out and I know what I want, or only I am a good arbiter of what I want.
sentences.chinese: 而是“我能想办法弄明白”的信心；我知道自己想要什么，也只有我自己才最有资格判断自己想要什么。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: Yeah. That level of self-belief, I suppose, allows you to determine what is it that matters to me, my self-esteem.
sentences.chinese: 嗯。我想，这种程度的自信让你能够判断：对我来说什么才重要，我的自尊是什么。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: Should I chase this thing or not? I can make a fair judgment on that as opposed to being so swayed.
sentences.chinese: 我该不该追求这件事？我能对此作出相对公正的判断，而不是那么容易被左右。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: But it’s such a good point about even if you think you’re not consciously logging the stuff that you’re doing,
sentences.chinese: 不过你说得特别好：即使你觉得自己并没有有意识地记录自己做过的事，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: there is some that’s in the back of your mind. Was it the daemon? Is that what the ancient Greeks or something used to talk about?
sentences.chinese: 脑海深处也总有一部分在记着。那是不是叫 daemon？古希腊人以前是不是谈过这个？
