sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: Yeah. Also in computer science, like there’s a concept of a daemon, which is a program that’s always running in the background. You can’t see it.
sentences.chinese: 对。在计算机科学里也有 daemon 这个概念，指一种一直在后台运行的程序。你看不见它。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: But yeah, it probably comes from the ancient Greek daemon.
sentences.chinese: 不过没错，这个词可能就来自古希腊的 daemon。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: But yeah, what you know that you don’t even know you know is far greater than what you know you know, right?
sentences.chinese: 不过说真的，那些你已经知道、却连自己都没意识到自己知道的东西，远比你明确知道自己知道的多得多，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: You can’t even articulate most of the things you know. There are feelings you have that have no words for them.
sentences.chinese: 你甚至说不清自己知道的大部分东西。有些感受，你根本找不到词来形容。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: There are thoughts you have that are felt within the body or subconsciously that you never articulate to yourself.
sentences.chinese: 有些念头是在身体里或潜意识中被感知的，你从来没有把它们清楚地说给自己听。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: You can’t articulate the rules of grammar, yet you exercise them effortlessly when you speak.
sentences.chinese: 你说不清语法规则，却能在说话时毫不费力地运用它们。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: So I would argue that your implicit knowledge and your knowledge that is unknown to yourself is far greater than the knowledge you can articulate and that you can communicate.
sentences.chinese: 所以我认为，你的隐性知识、那些连你自己都不知道的知识，远远多于你能清楚表达、能传达给别人的知识。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: And so at some level, you’re always watching yourself. That’s what your consciousness is, right?
sentences.chinese: 所以在某种程度上，你一直在观察自己。这就是你的意识，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: It’s the thing that’s watching everything, including your mind, including your body. So if you want to have high self-esteem, then earn your own self-respect.
sentences.chinese: 它就是那个观察着一切的东西，包括你的思维，也包括你的身体。所以，如果你想有较高的自尊，就要赢得自己的尊重。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: I had this idea, the internal golden rule. So the golden rule says, treat others the way that you should be treated, you want to be treated.
sentences.chinese: 我有个想法，叫“内在黄金法则”。通常的黄金法则说：你应该被怎样对待——你希望被怎样对待——就怎样对待别人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: The internal golden rule says, treat yourself like others should have treated you.
sentences.chinese: 而内在黄金法则说：像别人本应善待你那样，去善待你自己。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: And it was a riposte to maybe people that didn’t grow up with unconditional love in that way.
sentences.chinese: 这也算是对那些也许没有在无条件的爱里长大的人的一种回应。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 15 · Self-Doubt and Confidence

sentences.english: On the love thing…
sentences.chinese: 说到爱这件事……
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: One of the interesting things about love is you can try to remember the feeling of being loved.
sentences.chinese: 关于爱，有件有意思的事：你可以试着回忆被爱的感觉。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: So go back to when someone was in love with you or someone did love you.
sentences.chinese: 所以，回想某个人曾经爱上你、或者确实爱过你的时候。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: And like, really, you remember that feeling, like really sit with it and try to recreate it within yourself.
sentences.chinese: 然后真的去回忆那种感觉，认真体会它，试着在自己心里重新唤起它。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: And then go to the feeling of you loving someone and when you were in love, and I’m not even talking about romantic love, necessarily.
sentences.chinese: 然后再去体会你爱着某个人、你陷入爱里时的感觉。我说的不一定是浪漫爱情。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: So be a little careful there. I’m talking more about like love for a…
sentences.chinese: 所以这里要稍微注意。我更多指的是对……的爱。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: Sometimes it gets complex if you’re talking about past romantic love, right, a sibling or a child or something like that, or a parent.
sentences.chinese: 如果说的是过去的恋爱，有时会变得复杂——比如对兄弟姐妹、孩子之类的，或者对父母的爱。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: And think about when you felt love towards someone or something. And now which is better?
sentences.chinese: 想想你爱着某个人或某件事时的感觉。现在，哪一种更好？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: And I would argue that the feeling of being in love is actually more exhilarating than the feeling of being loved.
sentences.chinese: 我认为，自己去爱、投入爱中的感觉，实际上比被爱的感觉更令人振奋。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: Being loved is a little cloying, it’s a little too sweet, you kind of want to push the person away, it’s a little embarrassing.
sentences.chinese: 被爱有点甜得发腻，有点太甜了，你会有点想把对方推开，也有点让人不好意思。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: And you know that if that person is too much into it, that you feel constrained.
sentences.chinese: 而且你知道，如果对方投入得过头，你会觉得受束缚。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: On the other hand, the feeling of being in love is very expansive.
sentences.chinese: 另一方面，自己去爱的感觉是非常开阔的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: It’s very open, it actually makes you a better version of yourself, it makes you want to be a better person.
sentences.chinese: 它很敞亮，实际上会让你成为更好的自己，让你想成为一个更好的人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: And so you can create love anytime you want. It’s just that craving to receive it, that’s the problem.
sentences.chinese: 所以你随时都可以创造爱。真正的问题只在于那种想要得到爱的渴望。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 16 · The Nature of Love

sentences.english: The most expensive trait is pride. How come?
sentences.chinese: 代价最高的性格特点是骄傲。为什么这么说？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: Oh, that was a recent one. I tweeted that just because I think that pride is the enemy of learning.
sentences.chinese: 哦，那是最近的一句。我发那条推文，只是因为我认为骄傲是学习的敌人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: So when I look at my friends and colleagues, the ones who are still stuck in the past and have grown the least are the ones who were the proudest,
sentences.chinese: 所以当我看我的朋友和同事时，那些仍然困在过去、成长最少的人，正是那些最骄傲的人，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: because they sort of feel like they already had the answers. And so they don’t want to correct themselves publicly.
sentences.chinese: 因为他们多少觉得自己早就有了答案。所以他们不愿意公开纠正自己。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: And so this goes back to the fame conversation, you get locked into something you said, it made you famous, you’re known for that.
sentences.chinese: 这又回到我们之前谈的名声：你被自己说过的某句话锁住了，它让你出了名，你因此为人所知。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: And now you want to pivot or change. So pride prevents you from saying “I’m wrong.”
sentences.chinese: 现在你想转向或改变。所以骄傲让你说不出“我错了”。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: What’s pride in this context here?
sentences.chinese: 在这里，骄傲具体指什么？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: It could be as simple as you’re trading stocks, and then you don’t admit you were wrong, so you hang on to a lousy trade.
sentences.chinese: 简单来说，比如你在做股票交易，却不承认自己判断错了，于是一直抓着一笔糟糕的交易不放。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: It could be that you made a decision to, you know, marry someone or move somewhere or enter a profession,
sentences.chinese: 也可能是你决定了要，你知道的，和某人结婚、搬去某个地方，或者进入某个行业，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: it doesn’t work out, and then you don’t admit that you were wrong, so you get stuck in it.
sentences.chinese: 结果行不通，你却不承认自己错了，于是就被困在里面。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: It’s mostly about getting trapped in local maxima, as opposed to going back down and climbing up the mountain again.
sentences.chinese: 这主要就是被困在“局部最高点”里，而不是先下山，再重新爬上更高的山。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: And that’s why it’s an expensive trait, because you continue to need to repay it in one form or another.
sentences.chinese: 这就是为什么它是一种代价高昂的特质：你会以这样或那样的形式，不断为它付出代价。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: Yeah, you’re just stuck at a suboptimal point. It’s going to cost you money, it’s going to cost you success.
sentences.chinese: 是啊，你就卡在一个并非最优的位置。它会让你损失金钱，也会让你损失成功。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 17 · The Cost of Pride

sentences.english: The great artists always have this ability to start over, whether it’s Paul Simon or Madonna or U2, and I’m dating myself a little bit.
sentences.chinese: 伟大的艺术家总有重新开始的能力，不管是 Paul Simon、Madonna 还是 U2——这么举例有点暴露我的年纪了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: But even the great entrepreneurs, they’re just always willing to start over.
sentences.chinese: 不过就连伟大的创业者，也总是愿意从头再来。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: I’m always struck by the Elon Musk story where, you know, he did PayPal as X.com originally, actually, it was his financial institution that got merged into PayPal.
sentences.chinese: 我一直对埃隆·马斯克的故事印象很深：你知道，他最初其实是以 X.com 的名义做 PayPal 的——那是他的金融机构，后来并入了 PayPal。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: Well, it’s good that you’ve got the domain, you know what I mean?
sentences.chinese: 嗯，至少你还留着那个域名，你懂我意思吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: Yeah, exactly. I’ll just, I’ll park that, I’ll hold on to it. He’s consistent. He’s been using it for quite a while.
sentences.chinese: 对，没错。我就先，我先把这事放一边，把它留着。他一直很执着，这个域名他已经用了很久了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: And he said something like, along the lines of, “I made two hundred million dollars from the sale of PayPal,
sentences.chinese: 他说过大意是这样的话：“我卖掉 PayPal 赚了两亿美元，
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: I put one hundred million dollars into SpaceX, eighty million in Tesla, twenty in the SolarCity, and I had to borrow money for rent.”
sentences.chinese: 我往 SpaceX 投了一亿美元，往 Tesla 投了八千万，往 SolarCity 投了两千万，结果连房租都得借钱付。”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: Right? This guy is a perennial risk taker. He’s always willing to start over.
sentences.chinese: 对吧？这个人一直都是个敢冒险的人。他总是愿意重新开始。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: He doesn’t have any pride about being seen as successful or being seen as a failure. He’s willing to put it all on the line.
sentences.chinese: 他不在乎别人把他看成成功者还是失败者。他愿意把一切都押上。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: Back himself again each time.
sentences.chinese: 每次都再次押注自己。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: Back himself again each time. But the key thing is, he’s always willing to start over.
sentences.chinese: 每次都再次押注自己。但关键是，他总是愿意从头开始。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: Right? Even now, when he’s sort of made his new startup as a USA, right?
sentences.chinese: 对吧？即使现在，他某种程度上把美国当成了自己的新创业项目，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: He’s basically trying to fix it like he would fix one of his startups.
sentences.chinese: 他基本上是在像修复自己的某家创业公司那样，去修复它。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: And I think that is a willingness to look like a fool, and that is a willingness to start over.
sentences.chinese: 我认为，这就是愿意让自己看起来像个傻瓜，也是愿意重新开始。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: And a lot of people just don’t have that.
sentences.chinese: 而很多人就是做不到这一点。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
sentences.sourceTitle: Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: They become successful, or they become rich, or they become famous, and that’s it, they’re stuck. They don’t want to go back to zero.
sentences.chinese: 他们成功了、有钱了、出名了，然后就到此为止，被困住了。他们不想回到零。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over

sentences.english: And creating anything great requires zero to one, and that means you go back to zero, and that’s really painful and hard to do.
sentences.chinese: 而创造任何伟大的东西都需要从零到一；这意味着你得回到零，这真的很痛苦，也很难做到。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 18 · The Willingness to Start Over
