sentences.english: And vice versa?
sentences.chinese: 反过来呢？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: Well, you’re not killing serendipity in a way that…
sentences.chinese: 这么说，你这样并不是在扼杀偶然性……
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: No. I’m freeing up all my time, so my entire life is serendipity.
sentences.chinese: 没有。我把所有时间都腾出来了，所以我整个人生都是偶然性。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: I get to interact with whoever I want, whenever I want, wherever I want. So you hear the invite, but make the decision?
sentences.chinese: 我想和谁互动、什么时候、在哪里，都可以。所以你听到邀请，但由你来做决定？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: Because if there’s fewer things incoming, you’re assuming that you know best for you.
sentences.chinese: 因为如果进来的事情变少了，你就是在假定：你最清楚什么对自己最好。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: I don’t commit to anything in the future, so I’ll say, okay, if that thing is interesting, I’ll see if I can get in that day when I’m in the mood
sentences.chinese: 我对未来的事情一概不承诺，所以我会说，好吧，如果那件事有意思，到那天我心情对了，再看能不能去
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: but there’s nothing worse than something coming up that your past self committed you to, that your present self doesn’t want to do.
sentences.chinese: 但最糟糕的，莫过于过去的自己替你答应下来一件事，而现在的你根本不想做。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: God damn it.
sentences.chinese: 该死。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: Yeah, and then it destroys your entire calendar.
sentences.chinese: 对，然后它会毁掉你整本日历。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: It destroys your day because there’s like, oh, this one hour slot which is sitting like a turd on my calendar that I have to schedule my whole day around.
sentences.chinese: 它会毁掉你的一天，因为就像，哦，日历上有一个一小时的格子，像一坨东西搁在那儿，我整天都得围着它转。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: I can’t do anything at 20 minutes before or the 20 minutes afterwards.
sentences.chinese: 前后二十分钟我什么都做不了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: Even for phone calls, if someone wants to do a phone call, say, okay, just text me when you’re free, I’ll text you when I’m free, we’ll just do it on the fly.
sentences.chinese: 就算打电话也是，如果有人想打电话，就说，好，你有空就给我发短信，我有空也给你发短信，我们临时接通就行。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: It’s a much better way of living than this overly scheduled, you know, Cal.com or iCal, whatever.
sentences.chinese: 这比那种排得满满的 cal.com 或 iCal 之类的，好多了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: The over scheduled life is not worth living?
sentences.chinese: 排得过满的生活，不值得过？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: I think it’s a terrible way to live life.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得那是一种很糟糕的生活方式。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: That’s not how we evolved, it’s not how we grew up, it’s not how we were as children hopefully, unless you have a helicopter parent or a tiger mom.
sentences.chinese: 我们不是那样进化来的，不是那样长大的，小时候也希望不是那样——除非你有直升机父母或虎妈。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: Your natural order is freedom.
sentences.chinese: 你的自然状态就是自由。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: I had a friend who said to me once, “You know, I never want to have to be at a specific place at a specific time”
sentences.chinese: 我有个朋友曾经对我说：“你知道吗，我永远不想必须在某个特定时间出现在某个特定地点”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: and I was like, oh my god, that’s freedom.
sentences.chinese: 当时我就想，天哪，那才是自由。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: When I heard that, that’s changed my life right there.
sentences.chinese: 我听到那句话的时候，人生就在那儿被改变了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: You still alarm clockless?
sentences.chinese: 你现在还是不用闹钟的？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: Yes, I’m alarm clockless.
sentences.chinese: 对，我还是不用闹钟。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: Today, I did set my alarm clock just so I wouldn’t miss this.
sentences.chinese: 今天我倒是设了闹钟，只是为了别错过这次。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: But just so you know, I set the alarm clock, 11am in case I was stricken with a flu.
sentences.chinese: 不过跟你说一下，我把闹钟定在上午 11 点，以防我得了流感。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: I wasn’t going to set my alarm clock for 8am or 9am, and sure enough I got up many hours before that.
sentences.chinese: 我还是不会把闹钟定在 8 点或 9 点，果然，我早在那之前很多个小时就起来了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: But it was sort of a backup emergency alarm.
sentences.chinese: 但它只是一种备用的应急闹钟。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: In fact, sometimes when I have something that I need to do, I don’t want to look at a calendar, so I’ll just set an alarm for it.
sentences.chinese: 其实有时候，如果有件事我必须做，我又不想去看日历，我就直接给它设个闹钟。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: Just sink a little bit more into that, like kind of like that “fuck you” energy, that self-prioritizing energy, because I think people rationally love the idea of this.
sentences.chinese: 再多沉进去一点，那种“去你的”的劲头，那种把自己放在前面的能量，因为我觉得人们在理性上很喜欢这个想法。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: I’m gonna do what only I want to do, even if they’ve got the level of freedom.
sentences.chinese: 我只做自己想做的事——哪怕他们已经拥有那种程度的自由。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 21 · Embracing Serendipity

sentences.english: It’s not “fuck you” energy in the sense that I think everyone should live their life that way to the greatest extent possible.
sentences.chinese: 这并不是那种“去你的”的劲头，好像我认为每个人都应该尽最大可能那样生活。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: Obviously we have our requirements around work and obligations that are genuinely important to us
sentences.chinese: 显然我们都有工作和那些对自己真正重要的责任
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: but don’t fritter away your life on randomly scheduled things and things that aren’t important, don’t matter, and events and weddings and, you know, tedious dinners with tedious people that you don’t want to go to.
sentences.chinese: 但不要把人生浪费在随便安排的事情上，浪费在那些不重要、无所谓的事上，浪费在那些你不想去的活动、婚礼，以及和乏味的人吃的乏味晚餐上。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: To the extent you can bring freedom into your life, optimize for that, you’ll actually be more productive.
sentences.chinese: 只要你能把自由带进生活，就朝这个方向优化，你其实会更高效。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: You won’t just be happier, more free, you will be more productive, because then you can focus on what is in front of you, whatever the biggest problem of that day.
sentences.chinese: 你不只会更快乐、更自由，还会更高效，因为这样你就能专注于眼前的事，专注于那天最大的那个问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: When I wake up in the morning, the first four hours are when I have the most energy and that’s when I want to solve all the hard problems
sentences.chinese: 我早上醒来，前四个小时是精力最充沛的时候，我想在那段时间解决所有难的问题
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: and the next four hours are when I kind of want to do some more outdoorsy activities or I want to work out or maybe I can have some meetings
sentences.chinese: 接下来四个小时，我比较想做点户外活动，或者锻炼，或者也可以开一些会
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: but I’ll try to do those last second based on whatever the day’s priorities demand.
sentences.chinese: 但我会尽量拖到最后一刻，根据当天的优先级再决定。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: The last four hours I kind of want to wind down, I want to hang out with the kids
sentences.chinese: 最后四个小时我想慢慢收工，想陪孩子
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: and I want to play games, or read a book or something like that.
sentences.chinese: 也想玩游戏，或者看本书之类的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: So, having that flexibility and freedom is really important, so you can just put whatever is most needed into the slot at that moment.
sentences.chinese: 所以，拥有那种灵活和自由真的很重要，这样你就能在那个时刻，把最需要的事放进那个位置。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: Instead if I have like a meeting at 2pm and then I have to get a thing
sentences.chinese: 反过来，如果我下午 2 点有个会，然后还得把一件事
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: and some emails done, I put that off till 6pm and I’m rushing, I’m not going to be productive.
sentences.chinese: 和一些邮件做完，我把它拖到晚上 6 点，再一路赶，我就不会高效。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: You’re certainly not free.
sentences.chinese: 那你当然也不自由。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: I’m definitely not free, but also I really believe that inspiration is perishable.
sentences.chinese: 我肯定不自由。而且我还真正相信另一件事：灵感是容易变质的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: Act on it immediately.
sentences.chinese: 立刻行动。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: So when you’re inspired to do something, do that thing.
sentences.chinese: 所以当你受到启发要做一件事，就去做那件事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: If I’m inspired to write a blog post, I want to do it at that moment.
sentences.chinese: 如果我突然想写一篇博客，我就想在那个瞬间写。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: If I’m inspired to send a tweet, I want to do it that moment.
sentences.chinese: 如果我突然想发一条推，我就想在那个瞬间发。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: If I’m inspired to solve a problem, I want to do it at that moment.
sentences.chinese: 如果我突然想解决一个问题，我就想在那个瞬间解决。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: If I’m inspired to read a book, I want to read it right then.
sentences.chinese: 如果我突然想读一本书，我就想马上读。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: If I want to learn something, I do it at the moment of curiosity. The moment the curiosity arrives, I go learn that thing immediately.
sentences.chinese: 如果我想学一样东西，就在好奇心出现的那一刻去做，好奇心一到，我立刻去学那件事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: I download the book, I get on Google, I get on ChatGPT, whatever, I will figure that thing out on the spot, and that’s when the learning happens.
sentences.chinese: 我下载那本书，打开谷歌，打开 ChatGPT，不管怎样，我会当场把那件事搞明白，而学习就是在那时候发生的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: It doesn’t happen because I’ve scheduled time, because I’ve set an hour aside
sentences.chinese: 它不会因为我排了时间、空出一小时就发生
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: because when that time arrives I might be in a different mood, I might just want to do something different.
sentences.chinese: 因为那个时间到了，我可能是另一种心情，可能只想做别的事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: So I think that spontaneity is really important, you’re going to learn best when you’re having fun, when you genuinely are enjoying the process, not when you’re forced to sit there and do it.
sentences.chinese: 所以我觉得自发性真的很重要。你玩得开心、真心享受这个过程的时候，才学得最好，而不是被迫坐在那儿去做。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: How much do you remember from school?
sentences.chinese: 你还记得学校里多少东西？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: You know you were forced to learn geography, history, mathematics on this schedule at this time according to this person.
sentences.chinese: 你知道，你被强迫按这个时间表、在这个时间、照这个人的安排去学地理、历史、数学。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: All the stuff that sticks with you is what you learned when you wanted to, when you genuinely had the desire
sentences.chinese: 真正留在你身上的，都是你想学的时候、真心有欲望的时候学到的
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: and that freedom, that ability to act on something the moment you want to is so liberating that most of us go through our lives with very little tastes of that.
sentences.chinese: 而那种自由，那种想做的当下就能去做的能力，是如此解放，以至于我们大多数人一辈子只尝到很少一点。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: If you live your entire life that way, that is a recipe for happiness.
sentences.chinese: 如果你整个人生都那样过，那就是通往幸福的配方。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: It feels like efficiency that you have.
sentences.chinese: 感觉你拥有的是一种效率。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: You have the inspiration that is going to be the most frictionless time to ever do that particular task.
sentences.chinese: 你有灵感的时候，就是做那件特定事情最没有阻力的时刻。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: So I’ve had the inspiration to do that.
sentences.chinese: 所以我已经有做那件事的灵感了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: I’ll put that off until a time when I no longer really want to do it quite so much.
sentences.chinese: 我却把它推迟到一个我不再那么想做的时间。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: And while I do want to do that thing, I’ll do something else that I needed to do because it’s on the schedule.
sentences.chinese: 而在我真正想做那件事的时候，我却去做另一件必须做的事，因为它在日程上。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: It does not work.
sentences.chinese: 这行不通。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: Procrastination is because you don’t want to do that thing right now.
sentences.chinese: 拖延，是因为你现在不想做那件事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: You want to do something else.
sentences.chinese: 你想做别的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: Go do that something else.
sentences.chinese: 那就去做那别的事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: I reject this frame that efficiency and productivity and success are counter to happiness and freedom.
sentences.chinese: 我拒绝这种框架：效率、生产力和成功是跟幸福和自由相对立的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: They actually go together.
sentences.chinese: 它们其实是一起的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: The happier you are, the more you can sustain doing something, the more likely you’re going to do something that will in turn make you even happier
sentences.chinese: 你越快乐，就越能持续做一件事，也就越可能做出让你更快乐的事
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: and you’ll continue to do it and you’ll outwork everybody else.
sentences.chinese: 然后你会继续做下去，你会比任何人都更能坚持。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: The more free you are, the better you can allocate your time
sentences.chinese: 你越自由，就越能更好地分配时间
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: and the less you’re caught up in a web of obligations and commitments, and the more you can focus on the task at hand.
sentences.chinese: 你就越不会被一堆义务和承诺缠住，也就越能专注于手头的任务。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 22 · Freedom and Productivity

sentences.english: This is related to another insight of yours.
sentences.chinese: 这跟你的另一个洞察有关。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: The less you want something, the less you’re thinking about it, the less you’re obsessing over it, the more you’re going to do it in a natural way.
sentences.chinese: 你越不想要一件事，你越不去想它、不去执着它，你就越会以一种自然的方式去做。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: The more you’re going to do it for yourself, you’re going to do it in a way that you’re good at, and you’re going to stick with it.
sentences.chinese: 你越会为自己而做，越会用你擅长的方式做，也越会坚持下去。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: The people around you will see the quality of your work is higher.
sentences.chinese: 你周围的人会看到，你的作品质量更高。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: This seems like a difficult tension to navigate because an obsessive attention to detail is a competitive advantage of your work as well.
sentences.chinese: 但这看起来像一种很难处理的张力，因为对细节的执着，本身也是你工作的竞争优势。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: So you have these two things sort of conflicting with each other.
sentences.chinese: 所以这两件事好像在互相冲突。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: No one is gonna beat you at being you.
sentences.chinese: 没有人会在“做你自己”这件事上打败你。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: Find what feels like play to you, but looks like work to others.
sentences.chinese: 找到对你来说像玩、对别人来说却像工作的事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: So it looks like work to them, but to you it feels like play, it’s not work.
sentences.chinese: 所以对他们来说那是工作，对你来说却像玩，那不是工作。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: So you’re gonna out-compete them because you’re doing it, you’re doing it for fun, they’re doing it for work, they’re doing it for some by-product.
sentences.chinese: 所以你会胜过他们，因为你做起来毫不费力，你是为了好玩而做，他们是为了工作而做，是为了某种副产品而做。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: To you, it’s art, it’s beauty, it’s joy, it’s flow, it’s fulfilling.
sentences.chinese: 对你来说，那是艺术，是美，是喜悦，是心流，是充实。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: You must enjoy podcasting.
sentences.chinese: 你一定是享受做播客的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: If you didn’t, you wouldn’t be good at it.
sentences.chinese: 如果不是，你不会擅长。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: You wouldn’t have nine hundred episodes either.
sentences.chinese: 你也不会做到九百期。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: If you decided that the right way to get ahead in life was to go write books, nobody would have heard of you.
sentences.chinese: 如果你认定人生出人头地的正确方式是去写书，根本不会有人听说过你。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: Chris Williamson’s book would be a complete flop, that’s not who you are.
sentences.chinese: Chris Williamson 的书会彻底失败，那不是你这个人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: You’re a podcaster.
sentences.chinese: 你是个播客主持人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: You enjoy talking to people, you enjoy interviewing them.
sentences.chinese: 你享受和人聊天，享受采访他们。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: The more you do things that are natural to you, the less competition you have.
sentences.chinese: 你越做对自己自然的事，竞争就越少。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: You escape competition through authenticity by being your own self.
sentences.chinese: 你靠真实、靠做你自己，来逃离竞争。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 23 · Finding Your Authentic Work

sentences.english: If I had to summarize how to be successful in life in two words, I would just say productize yourself.
sentences.chinese: 如果必须用两个词来概括如何在人生中成功，我只会说：把你自己产品化。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: Just figure out what it is that you naturally do that the world might want that you can scale up and turn into a product, and it’ll eventually be effortless for you.
sentences.chinese: 只要弄清楚你天生会做、而世界可能需要、你又能放大并变成产品的那件事，最终它对你来说会毫不费力。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: Yes, there’s always work required, but it won’t even feel like work to you, it’ll feel like play to you, and modern society gives us that opportunity.
sentences.chinese: 是的，总还是需要付出努力，但对你甚至不会像工作，对你会像玩，而现代社会给了我们这个机会。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: Know, if you were two thousand years ago, you’re born on a farm, your choices are very limited, right, you’re going to do stuff on that farm.
sentences.chinese: 要知道，如果你在两千年前，你出生在一个农场上，你的选择非常有限，对吧，你就得在那个农场上干活。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: Now you can literally wake up and you can move to a different city, you can switch careers, you can switch jobs, you can change the people that you’re with, you know you can change so many things about who you are and who you’re with and what you’re doing that there is infinite opportunity out there for you, literally infinite.
sentences.chinese: 现在你简直可以一觉醒来搬到另一座城市，换职业，换工作，换身边的人，你能改变的，关于你是谁、和谁在一起、在做什么，有那么多，外面有无限的机会，字面意义上的无限。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: So it’s much better to treat this like a search function to find the people who need you the most, to find the work that needs you the most, to find the place you’re best suited to be at
sentences.chinese: 所以更好的做法，是把这当成一个搜索函数：去找到最需要你的人，找到最需要你的工作，找到你最适合待的地方
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: and it’s worthwhile to spend time in that exploration before diving into exploitation.
sentences.chinese: 而且值得先花时间探索，再进入利用。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: The biggest mistake in a world with so many choices is premature commitment.
sentences.chinese: 在一个选择如此之多的世界里，最大的错误就是过早承诺。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: If you prematurely commit to being a lawyer or a doctor and now you’ve got like five years invested into that, you might have just completely missed
sentences.chinese: 如果你过早地承诺去当律师或医生，并且已经在那上面投入了五年，你可能就完全走偏了
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: you might just end up in the wrong profession, wrong place, the wrong people for thirty years of your life grinding away
sentences.chinese: 你可能最终会待在错误的职业、错误的地方、错误的人身边，用三十年的人生去苦熬
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: and yes, the best time to figure that out was before, but the second best time is now, so just change it.
sentences.chinese: 是的，最好的想清楚时机是从前，但第二好的时机就是现在，所以就去改。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 24 · Productize Yourself

sentences.english: And also presumably kill things that aren’t working very quickly.
sentences.chinese: 而且大概也要很快砍掉那些不奏效的事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: By default, you should kill everything. If you can’t decide, the answer is no, and most things you should just be saying no to.
sentences.chinese: 默认情况下，你应该砍掉一切；你知道，如果你决定不了，答案就是不，而大多数事情你本来就该说不。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Part of my keeping my calendar is just by default saying no to everything.
sentences.chinese: 我之所以能把日历空着，一部分就是默认对所有事情说不。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Do I want to create a calendar just to add your event, right, or to add your need or your desire?
sentences.chinese: 难道我要专门建一个日历，只为了加上你的活动，对吧，或者加上你的需求、你的愿望？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: One of the other things about, know, early on in life you’re looking for opportunities
sentences.chinese: 另外还有一点，要知道，人生早期你在寻找机会
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: so you’re saying yes to everything, and that is a phase that you go through, that is the exploration phase.
sentences.chinese: 所以你对什么都说好，而那是你会经历的一个阶段，那是探索阶段。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Later when you found the thing you want to work on, you’re in the exploitation phase, you have to say no to everything by default
sentences.chinese: 后来当你找到了自己想做的事，你就进入了利用阶段，你必须默认对一切说不
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: and if you don’t say no to everything by default, if you have to even explicitly go out of your way to say no to something, that will take up time.
sentences.chinese: 如果你不默认对一切说不，如果你甚至还得特地跑去对某件事说不，那也会占用时间。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: For example, know there are lot of people out there who are into hustle culture
sentences.chinese: 比如说，要知道外面有很多人信奉 hustle culture（拼命文化）
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: and a big piece of hustle culture is like, well you’re not going get something if you don’t ask for it, so they’ll hustle people, they’ll always be sending you requests, messages.
sentences.chinese: 而这种文化很大一块就是：你不开口就得不到，所以他们会去“ hustle ”别人，不停给你发请求、发消息。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: This is a famous person problem but I have it
sentences.chinese: 这是名人会有的问题，而我也有
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: and people are always asking me for things and I kind of squirm when I get these messages
sentences.chinese: 总有人向我要这要那，我一收到这些消息就有点为难、不自在
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: and I’m sure you get these two text messages, emails saying, “Hey Chris, my friend so and so should really be on your podcast” or “you should come to my event,” “you should write a forward for my book,”
sentences.chinese: 而且我肯定你也会收到这两类短信、邮件，说：“嘿 Chris，我朋友某某某真的该上你的播客”，或者“你该来我的活动”，“你该给我的书写个序”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: and you kind of squirm when you get this right, and you have to figure out how to say no.
sentences.chinese: 你收到这种消息就会为难，然后还得想怎么拒绝。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: One of the things I learned along the way is that if you wouldn’t ask somebody else to do it
sentences.chinese: 我一路上学到的一件事是：如果这件事你自己都不会去求别人做
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: and then you get that request yourself, can just dismiss it, you don’t have to respond, you don’t even let it enter your brain.
sentences.chinese: 然后你自己却收到了这样的请求，就可以直接略过，你不必回复，甚至不必让它进到脑子里。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: You have to be able to delete emails and text messages without flinching if you want to scale, and scaling is very important, scaling your time is really important.
sentences.chinese: 如果你想把时间放大，就必须能毫不犹豫地删掉邮件和短信；放大很重要，放大你的时间真的很重要。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Every interruption will take you out of flow
sentences.chinese: 每一次打断都会把你带出心流
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: so the only way you can remain in flow is if you get either very good at ignoring these things by default or closing yourself off like a hermit like our mutual friend Tim Ferriss does
sentences.chinese: 所以你要保持在心流里，要么就得非常擅长默认忽略这些事，要么就像我们共同的朋友 Tim Ferriss 那样，把自己关起来当隐士
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: or you just become emotionally capable of not registering these as something that causes turbulence inside of you.
sentences.chinese: 要么你就在情绪上变得有能力，不把这些事登记成会在心里掀起波澜的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: That not registering it emotionally thing, is that fundamental?
sentences.chinese: 那种在情绪上不把它登记下来的能力，是根本性的吗？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: That’s so fundamental to so many things in life.
sentences.chinese: 它对生活里这么多事情都那么根本。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Can we dig into that a little bit?
sentences.chinese: 我们能再挖深一点吗？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Is it because again, I’ve only seen you as you.
sentences.chinese: 是不是因为，再说一次，我见到的一直是现在的你。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: I didn’t know you twenty years ago.
sentences.chinese: 二十年前的你，我不认识。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: I didn’t know you as a child.
sentences.chinese: 小时候的你，我也不认识。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: So I’ve only seen you with this holistic selfishness, the integrated self-prioritization, whatever, I don’t know.
sentences.chinese: 所以我见到的，一直是这种整体的自私、这种整合过的自我优先，不管我们——我也不知道我们当时怎么称呼它。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Selfish is fine.
sentences.chinese: 叫自私也行。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: I’ll take selfish.
sentences.chinese: 我接受“自私”。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: I’m a very selfish person.
sentences.chinese: 我是一个非常自私的人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Don’t contact me.
sentences.chinese: 别联系我。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Yeah, that emotional reaction.
sentences.chinese: 对，那种情绪反应。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Also get the sense too that maybe people have lived obligation life for so long that they actually kinda struggle to tap into what it is that they want.
sentences.chinese: 我也感觉，也许有人过义务的生活太久了，他们其实很难再碰到自己到底想要什么。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: They’ve hidden their wants and their desires and their needs, they deprioritized themselves so much for so long.
sentences.chinese: 他们把自己的想要、欲望和需要藏起来，把自己往后放了太久太久。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: They go, what do I want, actually?
sentences.chinese: 他们会想：我到底想要什么？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: What is it?
sentences.chinese: 是什么？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Do I want to go to this thing or not?
sentences.chinese: 我到底想不想去这个活动？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: Because all I’ve done is be fucking puppeted, right?
sentences.chinese: 因为我一直以来做的就是被该死地牵着走，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: I’ve been marionetted by other people’s desires for so so so long.
sentences.chinese: 我被别人的欲望当木偶牵了太久太久太久。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: I can’t even tap into that anymore, and saying no feels like a war crime.
sentences.chinese: 我甚至再也碰不到那个部分了，而说不，感觉像在犯战争罪。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 25 · Say No By Default

sentences.english: So I think it’s really good to be able to view your own mind and your own thoughts objectively, and that is the big benefit of meditation.
sentences.chinese: 所以我觉得，能够客观地看待自己的头脑和念头，是非常好的，而这就是冥想最大的好处。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: It creates a small gap between your conscious observation self and your mind
sentences.chinese: 它在你那个有意识的观察者自我和你的头脑之间，造出了一点空隙
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: and that lets you then look at your thoughts and evaluate them a little bit like you would a third party’s statements.
sentences.chinese: 那让你能够看着自己的念头，并有点像评估第三方的话那样去评估它们。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: If you just take your mind to be you and they’re integrated in one and the same at all times and you’re reacting from the mind
sentences.chinese: 如果你把头脑就当成你，它们始终完全合为一体，而你是从头脑里直接反应的
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: then you’re not even going question things that come into your mind.
sentences.chinese: 那你甚至不会去质疑进到脑子里的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: Anything that comes in that creates your reaction will immediately create a reaction, but if you can observe your thoughts a little bit and not in some woo woo way
sentences.chinese: 任何进来、会引发你反应的东西，都会立刻造成反应；但如果你能稍微观察一下自己的念头，而且不是那种玄乎的方式
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: but you can even just do it through therapy, can do it through journaling, you can do it any way you’d like
sentences.chinese: 你甚至可以通过心理咨询来做，可以通过写日记来做，用任何你喜欢的方式都可以
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: you can just take long walks, don’t have to meditate and do lotus position, all that is unnecessary.
sentences.chinese: 你也可以只是长时间散步，不必冥想、不必盘腿，那些都没必要。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: But if you can observe your own thoughts and view them a little objectively, then you can start being a little more choosy, a little more critical
sentences.chinese: 但如果你能观察自己的念头，并稍微客观地看待它们，你就可以开始更挑一点、更挑剔一点
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: and you can realize that there are no problems in the real world other than maybe things that inflict pain on your body.
sentences.chinese: 然后你会意识到，现实世界里其实没有什么问题，除了那些也许会给你身体带来疼痛的事情。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: Everything else has to become a problem in your mind first.
sentences.chinese: 其他一切，都必须先在你心里变成一个问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: You have to view it and interpret it and create a narrative that it is a problem before it becomes the problem.
sentences.chinese: 你必须先看见它、解释它，并编出一个“这是个问题”的叙事，它才会成为那个问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: Then you realize that a lot of your emotional energy is spent on reacting to things that your mind is automatically saying are problems, and you don’t need all those problems.
sentences.chinese: 然后你会意识到，你很多情绪能量，都花在对头脑自动判定为问题的事情作出反应上，而你并不需要那么多问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: Do you really need that many problems in your life?
sentences.chinese: 你的人生真的需要那么多问题吗？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: Again I would say try to focus on just one overarching problem and then go solve that problem.
sentences.chinese: 我还是会说，试着只聚焦一个总的问题，然后去解决那个问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: It’s like if you want to be successful, define success very concretely, focus on that
sentences.chinese: 就像如果你想成功，就把成功定义得很具体，把注意力放在那上面
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: and everything else, when it enters your mind it becomes a problem
sentences.chinese: 而其他一切，一旦进到脑子里，就会变成一个问题
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: whether it’s a judgment about the girl walking down the street or the car that just cut in front of you or whether it’s like, you know, your accountant did this stupid thing, like yes it’s going to trigger you
sentences.chinese: 不管是对街上走过的女孩的评判，还是刚刚加塞到你前面的那辆车，还是比如，你知道的，你的会计干了件蠢事，是的，它会触发你
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: but observe for a moment that like it’s triggering me, I’ve created a problem
sentences.chinese: 但先观察一下：它正在触发我，是我自己造出了一个问题
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: do I really want to have this problem right now, do I want to spend the energy on this problem or do I want that going somewhere else?
sentences.chinese: 我现在真的想要这个问题吗，我想把能量花在这个问题上，还是想把它用到别处？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: And it doesn’t have to be that over, you don’t have to, the mind mud wrestling with itself is also a problem.
sentences.chinese: 而且不必那么过头，你不必——头脑跟自己摔跤，本身也是一个问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: I have, my problems have got problems and I have a real problem about fixing my problems.
sentences.chinese: 我的问题还有问题，而我又对解决自己的问题这件事，真的很有问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: Yeah, exactly, and so you just, you’re going to be much happier and much more focused, again I think happiness and focus and success can kind of complement each other.
sentences.chinese: 对，没错。所以你只会更快乐、更专注，我还是觉得幸福、专注和成功可以彼此成全。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: You’re going to have much more energy, just think about it as mental energy
sentences.chinese: 你会有多得多的能量，就把它想成心理能量
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: you’re going to have much more mental energy to focus on the actual problems you want to solve if you don’t start unconsciously, subconsciously, reactively picking up problems everywhere.
sentences.chinese: 如果你不开始无意识地、潜意识地、反应式地到处捡问题，你就会有多得多的心理能量，去专注于你真正想解决的那些问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: So before anything can be a problem that takes up your emotional energy, you have to accept it as a problem, you can be choosy about your problems
sentences.chinese: 所以在任何事情能成为占用你情绪能量的问题之前，你得先接受它是一个问题，而你可以挑选自己的问题
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: and I’m not saying I’m perfect in that regard, but I think I’m better than I used to be.
sentences.chinese: 我不是说我在这方面已经完美了，但我觉得我比以前好一些。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 26 · Observe Your Thoughts Objectively

sentences.english: Well, lots of people are addicted to solving problems, right, so much so that sometimes people create problems when we don’t have any, simply so that we can solve them.
sentences.chinese: 嗯，很多人沉迷于解决问题，甚至到了有时没问题也要造出问题来，好让自己能去解决。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: We have that going on, and then even worse is we take on problems that we can’t affect.
sentences.chinese: 我们有这种情况，而更糟的是，我们还会接那些自己影响不了的问题。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: So, you know, another one of my little quips was, you know, a rational person can sort of find peace by cultivating indifference to things that are out of their control
sentences.chinese: 所以，你知道，我有一句小俏皮话是：一个理性的人，可以通过培养对那些自己控制不了的事情的冷淡，来获得某种平静
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: and I’m as guilty as anybody of doomsurfing on X or social media and getting worked up about things that I can’t do anything about, right?
sentences.chinese: 而我跟任何人一样有罪，也会在 X 或社交媒体上刷灾难，为那些我根本无能为力的事情焦虑，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: Like do I want to be fighting those battles in my mind when I literally cannot do anything about it?
sentences.chinese: 难道我真的想在脑子里打那些仗，而我实际上什么都做不了？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: So if you find yourself looping on a problem like you’re watching the news too much and you’re getting caught up in a problem you can’t do anything about, you have to step away from that
sentences.chinese: 所以如果你发现自己在一个问题上打转，比如你新闻看得太多，陷进一个你无能为力的问题里，你就得从那儿走开
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: and modern media is a delivery mechanism for mimetic viruses
sentences.chinese: 而现代媒体就是模因病毒的投送机制
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: and what’s happened now is, you know, one hundred years ago, five hundred years ago, if something wasn’t happening in your immediate vicinity, you wouldn’t hear about it.
sentences.chinese: 现在的情况是，你知道，一百年前、五百年前，如果某件事不是发生在你身边，你根本不会听说。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: It wouldn’t be a problem for you, but now every single one of the world’s problems has turned into a mimetic virus
sentences.chinese: 它对你就不会是个问题；但现在，世界上每一个问题都变成了一种模因病毒
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: which is going into the battlefield of the news and is trying to infect your mind in real time.
sentences.chinese: 它冲进新闻的战场，试图实时感染你的头脑。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: So that, yeah, so that you become obsessed with the war in Ukraine, is really far away, or you get obsessed with climate change or you get obsessed with AI doom or you get obsessed with whatever
sentences.chinese: 于是，对，于是你开始执着于乌克兰的战争，其实离得很远，或者执着于气候变化，或者执着于 AI 末日，或者执着于随便什么
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: and there’s nothing as riveting as the old religion, the world is ending, the world is ending, pay attention, the world is ending.
sentences.chinese: 而再没有什么比古老的宗教更抓人了：世界要完了，世界要完了，快看，世界要完了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: Cassandra Complex at global scale.
sentences.chinese: 全球规模的卡珊德拉情结。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: and I would argue that large percentages of population are essentially just infected with these mimetic viruses that have taken over their brain
sentences.chinese: 而且我会说，很大一部分人基本上就是被这些模因病毒感染了，它们占领了他们的大脑
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: and are causing them to do incredible gyration about things that probably aren’t even true or are greatly exaggerated
sentences.chinese: 让他们对那些很可能并不真实、或被大大夸张的事情，做出剧烈的折腾
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: but even to the extent they are true, are things that that person can do nothing about and they should put their own house in order first.
sentences.chinese: 但即便它们是真的，也是那个人无能为力的事，他们应该先把自己家里的事安顿好。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: So you know another little line I have for myself is your family is broken but you’re going to fix the world, right?
sentences.chinese: 所以我对自己还有另一句：你的家庭是破碎的，你却要去修这个世界，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: People are running out there to try and fix the world and their own lives are a—
sentences.chinese: 人们冲出去想修这个世界，而他们自己的生活却是一摊——
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: Oh my god.
sentences.chinese: 我的天。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: Right, and I think it defies credibility if you can’t fix your own life first.
sentences.chinese: 对。而且我觉得，如果你连自己的生活都修不好，那就站不住脚。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: I’m not going to take you seriously if you can’t fix your own life, like all these philosophers who you know seem like people you emulate
sentences.chinese: 如果你连自己的生活都修不好，我不会把你当回事，比如那些看起来让人想效仿、显得特别聪明的哲学家
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: and so smart or like these brilliant celebrities and they go off and commit suicide, well you just kind of invalidated your whole way of life.
sentences.chinese: 或者那些光鲜的名人，然后他们却去自杀了，那你等于把整套生活方式都否定了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: It’s like that line in No Country for Old Men where the killer is waiting for the protagonist and the protagonist shows up
sentences.chinese: 就像《老无所依》里的那句，杀手在等主人公，主人公到了
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: and the killer says, “Well you know if your set of rules brought you here, then what good are your rules?”
sentences.chinese: 杀手说：“如果你那套规则把你带到了这里，那你的规则还有什么用？”
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: I am self, I’m holistically selfish in that I want to be objectively successful in everything I set out to want.
sentences.chinese: 我是自我的，我是整体自私的，意思是：凡是我决心要的东西，我都想客观上取得成功。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 27 · Choose Your Problems Wisely

sentences.english: Yeah, you have one life, don’t settle for mediocrity.
sentences.chinese: 对，而且你只有一次人生，不要安于平庸。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: Don’t settle for mediocrity, and I think the only, like, people debate intelligence for example, right?
sentences.chinese: 不要安于平庸。而且我觉得，唯一的——比如人们会争论智力，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: We talked about IQ tests and all that
sentences.chinese: 我们会谈智商测试之类的
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: but I think the only true test of intelligence is if you get what you want out of life, and there are two parts to that.
sentences.chinese: 但我觉得对智力唯一真正的检验，是你是否从人生中得到了自己想要的东西，而这有两部分。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: One is getting what you want, so you know how to get it, and the second is wanting the right things, knowing what to want in the first place.
sentences.chinese: 一部分是得到你想要的，所以你知道怎么得到它；第二部分是想要正确的东西，首先知道该要什么。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: I could want to be a, you know, six foot eight basketball player, and I’m not going to get that, so it’s wanting the wrong thing.
sentences.chinese: 我可以想成为一个，你知道，六尺八的篮球运动员，而我得不到，所以那是想要了错误的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: That’s wanting something that you can’t get.
sentences.chinese: 那是在要一个你得不到的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: That’s wanting something you can’t get.
sentences.chinese: 那是在要一个你得不到的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: There’s also wanting something that you don’t want.
sentences.chinese: 也还有一种，是要一个你其实并不想要的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: Yeah, wanting something that’s a booby prize.
sentences.chinese: 对，要的是那种看起来像奖、其实是安慰奖的东西。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: There are plenty of booby prizes out there too, right?
sentences.chinese: 外面也有很多这种安慰奖，对吧？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: I haven’t heard that word in about twenty years.
sentences.chinese: 我大概二十年没听过这个词了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: Yeah, prizes that are just not worth having, or that create their own problems.
sentences.chinese: 对，那些根本不值得拥有、或者会自己制造问题的奖。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: Well, if you’re not careful, you can end up in a place in life not only that you don’t want to be, but one that you didn’t even mean to get to.
sentences.chinese: 但如果你不当心，你最后不仅会走到一个自己不想待的地方，甚至会走到一个你根本没打算去的地方。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 28 · Don’t Settle for Mediocrity

sentences.english: That’s if you’re kind of proceeding unconsciously.
sentences.chinese: 那通常是因为你有点无意识地往前走。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: And usually I think people end up there because they are going on autopilot with sort of societal expectations or other people’s expectations, or out of guilt or out of mimetic desire.
sentences.chinese: 我通常觉得，人们走到那儿，是因为他们开着自动驾驶，跟着社会期待或别人的期待，或出于内疚，或出于模因欲望。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Peter Thiel has this whole thing from René Girard about how mimetic desires, our desires, are picked up from other people
sentences.chinese: Peter Thiel 从勒内·基拉尔那儿讲过一整套：模因欲望就是从别人那儿捡来的欲望
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: and some of those are automatically baked into society like go to law school, go to med school, go to business school.
sentences.chinese: 其中有些已经自动烤进了社会，比如去法学院、去医学院、去商学院。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Or they might be from watching what your friends are doing and what the other monkeys are doing, or it might be what your parents’ expectations are.
sentences.chinese: 也可能来自看着朋友在做什么、看着其他猴子在做什么，或者来自父母的期待。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Guilt is just society’s voice speaking in your head, socially programmed so you’ll be a good little monkey and do things that are good for the tribe.
sentences.chinese: 内疚不过是社会的声音在你脑子里说话，被社会编程好，好让你做一只乖猴子，去做对部落有利的事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: But I think the best outcomes come when you think it through for yourself and decide for yourself, and I don’t think people spend enough time deciding.
sentences.chinese: 但我觉得最好的结果，来自你自己想清楚、自己做决定，而我不觉得人们花了足够的时间去做决定。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: For example, we run on these four-year cycles.
sentences.chinese: 比如说，我们按四年一个周期运转。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: In Silicon Valley, you go join a startup, you vest your stock over four years, that’s the standard.
sentences.chinese: 在硅谷，你加入一家创业公司，股权四年兑现，那是标准。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: In college, you go for four years, high school you go for four years.
sentences.chinese: 上大学四年，高中也是四年。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Some things take longer – you have children, they hit puberty nine years later, that’s like a nine-year cycle until that relationship changes.
sentences.chinese: 有些事更长——你有了孩子，九年后他们进入青春期，那就像一个九年的周期，直到那段关系发生变化。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: But we’re used to these fairly long cycles, multi-year cycles, in which we are committed to things.
sentences.chinese: 但我们习惯的是这些相当长的、多年的周期，在这些周期里我们被承诺绑住。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: You go to law school, four or five year cycle.
sentences.chinese: 你去法学院，四五年一个周期。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: You go be a lawyer, forty year cycle.
sentences.chinese: 你去当律师，四十年一个周期。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: These are very long cycles.
sentences.chinese: 这些都是非常长的周期。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: The amount of time we spend deciding what to do and who to do it with is very short, very, very short.
sentences.chinese: 我们花在决定做什么、和谁一起做上面的时间，却非常短，非常非常短。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: We spend three months deciding, one month deciding on a job where we’re going to be for ten years or five years.
sentences.chinese: 我们花三个月决定，花一个月决定一份要做十年或五年的工作。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: And because a lot of discovery is path dependent, where the next thing you find on the path is dependent on where you were on the previous path
sentences.chinese: 而且很多发现是路径依赖的，你在路上找到的下一件事，取决于你之前在哪条路上
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: you sort of start going down this vector that is a very long distance.
sentences.chinese: 于是你开始沿着这个向量走出去，那是一段非常长的距离。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: and that’s going to decide who their friends are, what their jobs are, their opportunity, their weather, their food supply, their air supply, quality of life.
sentences.chinese: 而这会决定他们的朋友是谁、工作是什么、机会如何、天气如何、食物供应、空气，还有生活质量。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: It’s such an important decision but people spend so little time thinking it through.
sentences.chinese: 这是如此重要的决定，但人们花那么少的时间去想清楚。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: I would argue that if you’re making a four-year decision, spend a year thinking it through, like really thinking it through.
sentences.chinese: 我会说，如果你在做一个四年的决定，就花一年去想清楚，是真正想清楚。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Twenty-five percent of the time.
sentences.chinese: 百分之二十五的时间。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Yeah, exactly, there’s the secretary theorem.
sentences.chinese: 对，没错，这就有秘书定理。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Don’t know if you know that one?
sentences.chinese: 不知道你知不知道那个？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Is that after you’ve done this many people, pick the best one of the next however many?
sentences.chinese: 是不是说，你先见过这么多人之后，再在接下来的人里挑最好的那个？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: The secretary theorem is this computer science professor trying to figure out how much time he should spend interviewing secretaries and then how long to keep the secretary.
sentences.chinese: 秘书定理是一位计算机科学教授想搞清楚：他该花多少时间面试秘书，然后又该把秘书留多久。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: So, let’s say he’s going to have a secretary for ten years, does he keep searching for one year, two years, three years, one month, two months, what is the optimal time?
sentences.chinese: 假设他要用一位秘书十年，那他该继续找一年、两年、三年，还是一个月、两个月，最优时间是多少？
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: And it turns out that the optimal time is somewhere around a third.
sentences.chinese: 结果最优大概在三分之一左右。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: About a third of the way through, you take the best person you’ve worked with and try to find someone that good or better.
sentences.chinese: 大约走到三分之一的时候，你拿自己共事过的最好的那个人当标准，再去找达到或超过那个标准的人。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: So by the time you’ve gone about a third of the way through, you have seen enough that you now have a sense of what the bar is
sentences.chinese: 所以当你大约走完三分之一，你已经看够了，知道门槛在哪里了
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: and then anybody who meets or exceeds that bar is good enough.
sentences.chinese: 然后任何达到或超过那条门槛的人，就足够好了。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: This applies to dating, this applies to jobs and careers, this applies generally.
sentences.chinese: 这适用于约会，适用于工作和事业，也普遍适用。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: But the interesting thing about the secretary theorem is that it’s actually not time based.
sentences.chinese: 但秘书定理有意思的地方在于，它其实不是基于时间的。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: It’s not based on one third of the time, it’s iteration based.
sentences.chinese: 它不是基于时间的三分之一，而是基于迭代次数。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: The number of candidates.
sentences.chinese: 是候选人的数量。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: The number of shots you took on goal.
sentences.chinese: 是你射门的次数。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: So, you want to have lots and lots of iterations.
sentences.chinese: 所以，你要有非常非常多次迭代。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: So in that sense you need to bail out quickly, and you need to be decisive quickly.
sentences.chinese: 所以从那个意义上，你需要很快退出，也需要很快做决定。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: You need to take opportunities quickly, and bail out quickly.
sentences.chinese: 你需要很快抓住机会，也很快退出。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Like if you go back and you look through failed relationships, probably the biggest regret will be staying in the relationship after you knew it was over.
sentences.chinese: 就像你回头看失败的关系，大概最大的后悔，会是在那一年已经结束后还留在这段关系里。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: Exactly, you should have left sooner.
sentences.chinese: 没错，你早该离开。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: The moment you knew it wasn’t going to work out, you should have moved on.
sentences.chinese: 你一旦知道它不会成功，就该向前走。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 29 · Navigating Life’s Decisions

sentences.english: So in that sense, I think Malcolm Gladwell popularized this idea of ten thousand hours to mastery.
sentences.chinese: 所以从那个意义上，我想马尔科姆·格拉德威尔普及了“一万小时走向精通”这个说法。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 30 · Iterations vs. Repetitions

sentences.english: I would say it’s actually ten thousand iterations to mastery.
sentences.chinese: 我会说，其实是一万次迭代走向精通。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 30 · Iterations vs. Repetitions

sentences.english: It’s not actually ten thousand, it’s some unknown number, but it’s about the number of iterations that drive the learning curve, and iteration is not repetition.
sentences.chinese: 其实不是一万这个数，而是某个未知的数字，但推动学习曲线的，是迭代的次数，而迭代不是重复。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 30 · Iterations vs. Repetitions

sentences.english: Repetition is a different thing.
sentences.chinese: 重复是另一回事。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 30 · Iterations vs. Repetitions

sentences.english: Repeating is doing the same thing over and over.
sentences.chinese: 重复是把同一件事做了一遍又一遍。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 30 · Iterations vs. Repetitions

sentences.english: Iteration is modifying it with learning and then doing another version of it.
sentences.chinese: 迭代是带着学习去修改，然后再做下一个版本。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 30 · Iterations vs. Repetitions

sentences.english: So that’s error correction.
sentences.chinese: 那就是纠错。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 30 · Iterations vs. Repetitions

sentences.english: So if you get ten thousand error corrections in anything, you will be an expert at it.
sentences.chinese: 所以如果你在任何事情上得到一万次纠错，你就会成为这方面的专家。
sentences.source: Modern Wisdom · youtu.be/KyfUysrNaco · Topic 30 · Iterations vs. Repetitions
